descriptions.zh: 很显然[Root.GetName]曾经遭遇了一场灾难并留下了超量的辐射。但是原因尚不明确。随着在[Root.GetName]定居的殖民者不断增加，这个谜团开始越发让人烦恼。毕竟，如果连原因都不知道，我们又该怎么防止悲剧再次重演？
descriptions.en: While it's obvious that some past calamity released a vast amount of radiation on [Root.GetName], it's not obvious what caused it. This mystery is now bothering more and more of the colonists who have made [Root.GetName] their home. After all, if we don't know how this happened, what is to say it could not happen again?

descriptions.zh: 尽管[Root.GetName]上的大量辐射显然是过去的某起大灾难释放的，但我们仍未判明其具体原因，或者是否会再次发生这种现象。
descriptions.en: While it's obvious that some past calamity released a vast amount of radiation on [Root.GetName], we have yet to determine its cause or whether it is likely to happen again.

label.en: Let's get to the bottom of this!

tooltips.zh: 调查开始……
tooltips.en: The investigation starts...

descriptions.zh: 在彻底调查后，我们得出的结论是在遥远的古代[Root.GetName]上曾发生过灭绝事件。目前我们可以确定的是，当时[Root.GetName]上的本土居民已经快要发展为具有遨游太空能力的物种，但一个更加先进的物种突然闯入他们的恒星系，从轨道轰炸了[Root.GetName]然后再次离开，而少数幸存者也只能坐以待毙。
descriptions.en: After a thorough investigation, we have come to the conclusion that [Root.GetName] was the site of an ancient genocide. As far as we can determine, the native population of [Root.GetName] was on the verge of becoming a space-faring race when a far more advanced race suddenly entered the system, bombarded [Root.GetName] from orbit, and left again, leaving the few survivors doomed to extinction.

label.zh: 研究轰炸遗址，了解所使用武器的细节。
label.en: Study the impact sites for details of the weapons used.

options.script:
name = colony_mod.6.a
add_deposit = d_ancient_bombardment_craters

descriptions.zh: 在彻底调查后，我们得出的结论是[Root.GetName]是某场被遗忘的战争的牺牲品。谁曾经住在这里，以及他们与谁交战已经不得而知，但很明显他们是在与来自星系外的袭击者们争夺这颗星球时被消灭的。尽管这个发现令人心寒，我们至少可以肯定这种事不太可能会再次发生。
descriptions.en: After a thorough investigation, we have come to the conclusion that [Root.GetName] was a casualty in some forgotten war. Who lived here and who they fought is unknown, but it is clear that they were wiped out following an extra-solar invasion force entering the system and the ensuing battle for the planet. While this is a chilling realization, we can at least be reasonably sure that it is unlikely to happen again.

label.en: Study what remains of the battlefields.

options.script:
name = colony_mod.7.a
add_deposit = d_ancient_battlefield

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]的历史悲剧被揭开。很久以前，[Root.GetName]在两支相互竞争的强大势力之下艰难生存。到了某个时间节点，他们之间爆发了战争，战争愈演愈烈，直至[Root.GetName]上所有的高等生命由于核武器滥用而被全部毁灭。
descriptions.en: The tragic history of [Root.GetName] has been uncovered. Long ago, it seems that [Root.GetName] was dominated by two competing superpowers. At some point war broke out between them and the conflict escalated until all advanced life on [Root.GetName] was eliminated by excessive use of nuclear weapons.

descriptions.zh: 很久以前，[Root.GetName]似乎有两支互相竞争的强大势力。他们之间爆发了战争，而冲突不断加剧，直到[Root.GetName]上所有的高等生物都因滥用核能武器而被消灭了。
descriptions.en: Long ago, it seems that [Root.GetName] was dominated by two competing superpowers. At some point war broke out between them and the conflict escalated until all advanced life on [Root.GetName] was eliminated by excessive use of nuclear weapons.

label.zh: 究竟是什么导致他们到达如此的地步呢？
label.en: What could drive people to such a fate?

options.script:
name = colony_mod.8.a
add_deposit = d_irradiated_ruins

descriptions.zh: 尽管对[Root.GetName]历史进行了广泛调查，我们还是不知道这里曾经发生了什么。过去依然是一个谜。
descriptions.en: Despite extensive research into the history of [Root.GetName] we just don't know what happened here. The past remains a mystery.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]的当地生命体型庞大，远远超出了所能设想的生物体型极限。研究人员思索：“为什么它们这么大？对我们可有益处？”进一步详细研究原生生物的建议书蜂拥而至。
descriptions.en: The native life of [Root.GetName] is built on an epic scale, far larger than anyone previously thought was possible for biological life. The question now in the minds of our researchers is "What is their secret, and can we benefit from it?" Proposals to study the native life in greater detail are flooding in.

options.script: name = colony_mod.2.b

label.zh: 确保研究不会对它们造成伤害。
label.en: Ensure that the research does no harm.

label.zh: 研究它们？猎杀它们然后再看看有没有用处！
label.en: Study them? Harvest them and see if anything is useful!

descriptions.zh: 经过一段时期的调查研究，[Root.GetName]的科学家终于获得了突破并且成功实现了与一些巨兽的简单交流。尽管个头巨大，动作迟缓，并且难以沟通，泰坦巨兽们依然难以置信的坚韧和强壮。有一些表达了加入我们军团的意愿，他们毫无疑问会成为我们的杀手锏。
descriptions.en: After a period of research and study, the scientists on [Root.GetName] have managed to make a breakthrough and achieve limited communications with some of the Titans. While huge, slow, and difficult to talk to, the Titans are incredibly tough and strong. Some few have expressed a desire to join our military forces, where they will undoubtedly be an incredible asset.

tooltips.zh: 现在可以在这里招募泰坦巨兽了。
tooltips.en: Titanic Beasts can now be recruited here.

tooltips.zh: 泰坦巨兽如今可纳入招募对象，有大量泰坦巨兽的区域如今也可安全进行殖民。
tooltips.en: Titanic Beasts can be recruited here, and even areas with high numbers of Titanic Life are safe for colonists now.

descriptions.zh: 一场灾难性的连锁反应中，[Root.GetName]的科学家触怒了当地的泰坦巨兽。巨大的生物在殖民地肆虐，将他们前行道路上的一切都粉碎殆尽。
descriptions.en: In a disastrous series of events, the scientists on [Root.GetName] have enraged the indigenous Titanic Life. Huge creatures are rampaging across the colony, smashing everything in their path.

options.script:
name = TERRIBLE
custom_tooltip = titanic_uprising_tooltip

tooltips.zh: 泰坦巨兽正在到处杀戮！
tooltips.en: Titanic Beasts are killing everyone!

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]不稳定的板块构造再次发生了剧烈变动。关于殖民地损失的报告刚刚送达。
descriptions.en: The unstable tectonic plates of [Root.GetName] have just violently shifted once again. Reports on the damage to the colony are just starting to arrive.

tooltips.zh: 报告将于近期寄出。
tooltips.en: The reports will be sent shortly.

descriptions.zh: 近期发生在[Root.GetName]的地震在当地的殖民地造成了一个巨大的陷坑。无论那里曾经有什么，现如今都陷入地下的深渊了。
descriptions.en: The recent earthquake which shook our colony on [Root.GetName] has caused a large sinkhole to open. Whatever once occupied that spot is now deep underground.

descriptions.zh: 近期发生在[Root.GetName]的地震虽然撼动了我们的殖民地，但没有造成任何损伤。令人惊喜的是，这场地震反而让我们发现了一批有用的矿脉。
descriptions.en: The recent earthquake which rocked our colony on [Root.GetName] caused no damage and, serendipitously, has uncovered a batch of useful minerals.

descriptions.zh: 近期发生在[Root.GetName]的地震虽然撼动了我们的殖民地，但没有造成任何损伤。
descriptions.en: The recent earthquake which staggered our colony on [Root.GetName] caused no damage!

options.script: name = GOOD

titles.zh: 观测到彗星经过行星环带

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]的居民正在见证一出壮观的景象。一颗彗星正在经过[Root.GetName]的行星环带，效果被形容为“惊心动魄”。
descriptions.en: The population of [Root.GetName] are currently witnessing a spectacular sight. A comet is passing through [Root.GetName]'s asteroid belt and the effect is being described as "magnificent."

descriptions.zh: 毋庸置疑，[Root.GetName]大气中令人陶醉的效果让人无比享受，甚至在某些方面颇有助益，然而[Root.Owner.GetName]的保守派多次施加压力，要求清除这些可能产生依赖性的气体。
descriptions.en: While it cannot be denied that the intoxicating effects of [Root.GetName]'s atmosphere are enjoyable, and even helpful in some cases, there is pressure from the more conservative parts of the [Root.Owner.GetName] to crack down on the possibly addictive gases.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]大气中的致幻成分被全部清除了！
descriptions.en: The atmosphere of [Root.GetName] has been cleansed of its intoxicating elements!

options.script:
name = GOOD
remove_modifier = "atmospheric_hallucinogen"

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]大气经过过滤，致幻的效果已经大幅削弱。
descriptions.en: The atmosphere of [Root.GetName] has been filtered to greatly reduce the effects of the hallucinogen.

tooltips.zh: 啊，新鲜的空气！
tooltips.en: Ahh, fresh air!

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]周围的强力磁场最近在影响地面上的电脑。奇怪的是，这个影响并不是单纯地随机干扰，正相反，电脑实际上比预想中运行的更有效率了。这简直是老天相助……
descriptions.en: The Strong Magnetic Field around [Root.GetName] has been affecting computers on the surface recently. Oddly, this effect is not merely random interference, instead computers are actually working more efficiently than they should be. It's almost as if an outside force is lending a helping hand...

descriptions.zh: 环绕[Root.GetName]的强力磁场一直都在干扰着地表的电子仪器，但最近对我们的电脑造成的影响尤为严重。到目前为止我们仍不清楚事态的起因，不过我们猜测这应该是暂时性的。
descriptions.en: The Strong Magnetic Field around [Root.GetName] has always caused some problems with electronic instruments on the surface, but recently the effect on our computers has been especially notable. So far, it is unknown what has caused this flare up, although we suspect it to be temporary.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]是一台无比复杂而精细的自组织量子电脑。它的气候规律，当地生物，甚至我们的殖民地都被它当作神经元，整合进了星球大小的网络中。我们无法掌握其原理，也无法控制它，但如果我们以某种特定的方式来布置我们的电脑，[Root.GetName]将会增强其性能。
descriptions.en: [Root.GetName] is the site of a self-organizing quantum computer of astounding complexity and subtly. The patterns of the weather, the native life, even our own colony is incorporated into it and somehow used as neurons in a planet-sized network. We do not understand how this is possible, and we have no way of controlling it, but we do know that if we arrange our computers in a certain way [Root.GetName] will enhance their performance.

descriptions.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上定居了一段时间之后，我们收集到了一些奇怪的数据。具体来讲，[event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName]的地质构成似乎与[Root.GetName]大相径庭。这意味着它不是与星球同时形成的，而是原本在别处形成，后来不知怎的被[Root.GetName]的重力场捕获了。至于[event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName]到底源自何处仍是个谜。
descriptions.en: Now that [Root.GetName] has been settled for a while, some data irregularities have been noticed. Specifically, the moon [event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName] does not seem to be made of remotely similar material to [Root.GetName]. This suggests it was not formed at the same time, but rather originally formed elsewhere and somehow was captured by the gravity of [Root.GetName] at a later date. Quite where [event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName] came from is currently a mystery.

descriptions.zh:
[event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName]的神秘面纱终于被揭开了！详细勘探后发现该卫星的质量分布不均匀，略微突出的一端占有异常大的质量比。我们认为，此现象的是因为[event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName]曾经环绕着某个现已因剧烈爆炸而消失的行星公转的缘故。

[event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName]密度大的一端曾经是面向那颗行星，而在行星爆炸时部分碎片冲击向[event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName]并合为一体，并且该冲击力最终将卫星撞进[Root.GetName]的引力范围中。

由于卫星远端地表上拥有较高浓度的暗物质，我们相信该爆炸的行星是被某种基于暗物质的武器或能源所毁灭。
descriptions.en:
The mysteries of [event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName] have been revealed! A detailed survey revealed that the moon is slightly lopsided, with the far side of the moon having a disproportionately large share of the total mass. The reason for this, we believe, is that [event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName] once orbited another planet which was destroyed in a cataclysmic explosion.

The extra thickness on the far side of [event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName] is because that was the side which faced its original planet, the extra material is part of the mass of that planet which was blown into [event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName], knocking it out of orbit and sending it, eventually, into the orbit of [Root.GetName].

We speculate that the planet was destroyed by a weapon, or perhaps just an attempt to create a power source based on Dark Matter, as there are high concentrations of it in the planetary material coating the far side of the moon.

descriptions.zh: 谜团真是接踵而至。现在我们已经知道[event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName]是从另一个次元拖到，或是被送到了[Root.GetName]的轨道上。但我们仍不知道具体原因，因为除了背景辐射稍有差异之外，[event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName]似乎平淡无奇。至于在[event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName]中心发现的机器，它似乎可以进行次元转移，其原理就更令人费解了。目前对我们来说，这无异于是魔法。
descriptions.en: Unraveling one mystery has lead to another. We now know that [event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName] was drawn, or was sent, into the orbit of [Root.GetName] from another dimension. Unfortunately, we have no idea why, as besides a slightly different level of background radiation [event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName] seems utterly unremarkable. Still more baffling is how the machinery found at the center of [event_target:roguemoon.Planet.GetName], which presumably enabled the dimensional shift, works. For now, it might as well be magic.

descriptions.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上的偏远地区发现了一个只能被认是位面传送门的东西。天气预报算法发现了奇怪的气流，最终被认为是大气从传送门轻微泄漏造成的。大气流失的速度十分缓慢，对[Root.GetName]上的生活不会造成什么影响。但这个传送门的存在引起了一些令人担忧的问题，比如它通向哪里，以及会不会有什么东西从传送门另一侧穿过来？
descriptions.en: What can only be described as a dimensional portal has been discovered in a remote location on [Root.GetName]. Weather prediction algorithms noticed a strange air current, which was eventually determined to be caused by the slight leakage of atmosphere into the portal. The rate of loss is far too small for it to make any difference to life on [Root.GetName], but the very existence of this portal raises some disturbing questions, such as where does it lead to, and could something come through the portal from the other side?

options.script:
name = INTRIGUING
enable_special_project = {
			name = "DPORTAL_PROJECT"
			location = this
			owner = root
		}
add_deposit = d_portal_research_zone

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]上的位面传送门似乎是通向某个邪恶的世界的。尝试跟该位面进行任何类型接触的生物体都会遭受到剧烈的痛楚，若是持续数分钟暴露在这种痛楚下，会产生强烈的暴力倾向。就连简单的采集该怪异位面的数据都会导致电脑系统出现不可修复的故障，或使得智能个体产生极大的不适。然而，我们发现骑士团的一件遗珍可以有效地保护佩戴者，并且可以让我们派出一名骑士进入。
descriptions.en: The Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] seems to lead to a realm of evil and disquiet. Any direct contact with material from this dimension causes intense suffering in the subject, which if continued for more than a few minutes leads to intense violent urges. Even simply studying data recorded in the strange dimension causes cascading errors in computer systems, or intense discomfort in sapient beings. However, we have found that one of the Order's relics wards its wearer effectively, and would allow us to send a single knight through.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]上的位面传送门似乎通向了某个邪恶不安的世界。与该位面的物质发生任何接触都会导致接触主题遭受强烈的痛楚，若持续超过几分钟则不但会产生自杀倾向，还会尝试毁坏自己的感觉器官。即便只是研究从这个怪异次元采集来的数据也会对电脑系统造成连锁性的故障，对智慧生物而言则会有一种仿佛自己的灵魂正在遭受腐蚀一般强烈的不适感。
descriptions.en: The Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] seems to lead to a realm of evil and disquiet. Any and all contact with material from this dimension causes intense suffering in the subject, which if continued for more than a few minutes leads to intense suicidal urges coupled with attempts to mutilate their sensory organs. Even simply studying data recorded in the strange dimension causes cascading errors in computer systems, or intense discomfort in sapient beings due to the terrifying realization that one's very soul is being corrupted.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]上的位面传送门似乎是通向某个从本质上对立于智慧意识的世界。与该位面的物质发生任何接触都会导致接触主题遭受强烈的痛楚，若持续超过几分钟则不但会产生自杀倾向，还会尝试毁坏自己的感觉器官。即便只是研究从这个怪异次元采集来的数据也会对电脑系统造成连锁性的故障，对智慧生物而言则会有一种仿佛自己的灵魂正在遭受腐蚀一般强烈的不适感。
descriptions.en: The Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] seems to lead to a realm which is opposed to the sapient mind on a fundamental level. Any and all contact with material from this dimension causes intense suffering in the subject, which if continued for more than a few minutes leads to intense suicidal urges coupled with attempts to mutilate their sensory organs. Even simply studying data recorded in the strange dimension causes intense discomfort in the biological observer, and cascading errors in computer systems.

label.en: Find a way to close the Portal!

label.zh: 祈祷能够找到解决方法
试试用石头填满传送门！
label.en: Try filling the Portal with rocks!

options.script:
name = colony.3006.keep
add_deposit = d_portal_research_zone
custom_tooltip = portal_zone_tooltip

tooltips.zh: 可以对位面传送门进行长期研究。
tooltips.en: The Dimensional Portal can be studied on an ongoing basis.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现传送门可以容纳几乎无限的能量，但关键字是“几乎”。通过以前所未有的规模生产能量，并对传送门进行持续轰炸，最终导致传送门过载并坍塌了。很显然，生产巨大能量的能力也可以用于其它领域。
descriptions.en: The Portal was determined to be able to handle almost unlimited energy input, but the key word is "almost". By generating energy at an unprecedented scale and continuously bombarding the Portal, it was eventually possible to cause it to overload and collapse in on itself. Needless to say, the generation of vast amounts of energy has the potential to be useful in other areas.

tooltips.zh: 传送门原址仍可供研究，但获得的数据将不如以前那般有用。
tooltips.en: The Portal site can still be studied, but it will provide less useful data.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现传送门对灵能力非常敏感。因此我们召集了一些天赋异禀的个体，在传送门周围制造了一个灵能屏障，将它与世隔绝开。这一经历启发了我们，并且证明了用灵能创造实体屏障是可行的。
descriptions.en: The Portal proved to be sensitive to psionic force. With an assembled team of gifted individuals, we created a psionic barrier around the portal, preventing any access. The experience was enlightening and provides strong evidence that it is possible to form solid barriers from psionic energy.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现传送门对灵能输入非常敏感。我们利用灵能单元在传送门周围创造了一个灵能屏障，避免未授权访问。该事件获取的数据会在未来研究中大有可用。
descriptions.en: The Portal has proven to be sensitive to psionic input. Through the use of our psionic units, a barrier has been constructed around the portal, preventing unauthorized access. The data from this event will prove useful in our future research.

descriptions.zh: 传送门似乎会对附近观察者的思维产生某种反应，有些人产生的反应比其他人更大。通过筛选，我们挑选了一大群对传送门影响较大的人，用共同的意念关闭了传送门。这一经历启发了我们，并确实证明了信念的力量能被实际运用。
descriptions.en: The Portal seemed to react in some way to the thoughts of nearby observers, some more than others. Through a process of elimination it was possible to find a large number of people who were especially potent at influencing the Portal, and together they were able to effectively will the Portal to close. The experience was enlightening and provides strong evidence that it is possible to harness and direct belief in tangible ways.

tooltips.zh: 传送门原址仍可供研究，但获得的数据将不如以前那般有用。
tooltips.en: The Portal site can still be studied, but it will provide less useful data.

descriptions.zh: 有时最简单的答案也是最好的答案。在将数座大山炸成碎石并倒进传送门之后，它似乎过载了，也有可能是被刻意关闭了。无论如何，我们仍将剩余的碎石倒在了传送门的位置上，以防止它再次开启。我们从这一经历中吸取了许多工程与采矿方面的经验，可以在其它领域派上用场。
descriptions.en: Sometimes a simple answer is the best answer. After blasting several mountains into gravel and dumping the result into the portal, it seems to have been overloaded. Or, perhaps, was deliberately shut down. Regardless, the remaining material was dumped on top of the site in case it ever re-opens. The experience of such a large engineering and mining project will also prove useful in other areas.

tooltips.zh: 传送门原址仍可供研究，但获得的数据将不如以前那般有用。
tooltips.en: The Portal site can still be studied, but it will provide less useful data.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]上的位面传送门似乎是通向由纯能量所形成的世界。我们成功通过传送门汲取少量的能量过来我们的世界。这些能量“包裹”拥有开发成武器的潜力。
descriptions.en: The Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] leads to a dimension of pure energy, a small amount of which can be siphoned through the portal for our own use. The procedures used to handle discrete "packets" of energy also have potential use as a weapons system.

tooltips.zh: 位面传送门研究者也将生产£energy£ 能量币
tooltips.en: Dimensional Portal Researchers will also produce £energy£ Energy

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]上的位面传送门通往一个由纯粹的熵构成的次元。就连传感器都几乎无法取得读数，因为我们信号的能量很快就消散了。最具可信度的理论是，这一“太虚”的大多数零点能量都为负，任何曾经存在的正能量都早已耗尽。我们或许可以制造一种武器，将太虚的能量消散特性化为武器。
descriptions.en: The Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] leads to a dimension of pure entropy. It is difficult to even get sensor readings because the very energy of our pings is rapidly dissipated. Our best theory is that this "Null Void" is a dimension where the majority of zero-point energy is negative and so any positive energy which was once present has long since been used up. Knowing this, it might be possible to construct a weapon which can use the Null Void's energy destruction offensively.

tooltips.zh: 位面传送门研究者也将生产£sr_dark_matter£ 暗物质
tooltips.en: Dimensional Portal Researchers will also produce £sr_dark_matter£ Dark Matter

descriptions.zh: 在多年的研究之后，[Root.GetName]上的某些研究者们觉得自己开始理解太虚了。有一些……波动。力量。一股流动轻柔地通过传送门流向[From.GetName]，并带来我们可以收集的微量暗物质。从理论上讲，我们应该可以使我们的传送门对这股波动更加“显眼”，以此产生更多的暗物质。
descriptions.en: After years of study, some researchers on [Root.GetName] are beginning to feel they understand the Null Void. There are... currents. Forces. Some flow which gently pushes against the portal to [From.GetName], bringing the traces of Dark Matter we are able to collect. In theory it should be possible to make our portal more "visible" to this force, which should result in a larger harvest.

descriptions.zh: 一座巨大的信号增幅器将一道能量射入了[Root.GetName]上的传送门。效果立竿见影，传送门另一端的压力明显开始增加，并涌出了更多的暗物质流。
descriptions.en: A vast signal amplifier has sent a blast of energy through the portal on [Root.GetName]. The effect was immediate, the pressure on the far side of the portal is noticeably stronger, and with it comes an increased flow of Dark Matter.

descriptions.zh: 奇怪的是，[Root.GetName]上的位面传送门似乎通往一个与[Root.GetName]非常相似的星球。更奇怪的是，里面有一个信号正向我们传来……
descriptions.en: Strangely, the Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] seems to connect to a planet which looks very much like [Root.GetName]. Stranger still, there's a signal being broadcast to us through it...

descriptions.zh: 我是[Root.Owner.GetName]的[Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]。传送门外星人，你们是谁？
descriptions.en: This is [Root.Owner.Leader.GetName] of the [Root.Owner.GetName]. Who are you, Portal-aliens?

descriptions.zh: 这里是[Root.Owner.GetName]的[Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]。表明你的身份！
descriptions.en: This is [Root.Owner.Leader.GetName] of the [Root.Owner.GetName]. Identify!

label.zh: 校验错误：身份无效！这里是[Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]！表明你的身份！
label.en: Checksum error: invalid ID! This is [Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]! Identify!

descriptions.zh: 这太神奇了。如果你说的是真的，我想这座传送门应该是连通平行世界的桥梁。我们都是[Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]，但在某一时点上，我们各自次元中一定发生了某种差异，使我们的世界线产生了分歧。
descriptions.en: Fascinating. If what you say is true, I think this portal bridges the gap between alternate dimensions. We are both the [Root.Owner.Leader.GetName], but at some point an event must have caused our respective dimensions to diverge.

descriptions.zh: **§Y处理中！§!** 结果：这道传送门连通着次元之间的缝隙。我们都是[Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]，来自不同的次元。
descriptions.en: **§YPROCESSING!§!** Results: This portal bridges the gap between alternate dimensions. We are both [Root.Owner.Leader.GetName], from divergent dimensions.

label.zh: 真神奇。告诉我们你们那的[Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural]过得如何。
label.en: Amazing. Tell us how your [Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural] fare!

label.zh: 我们应该通过传送门进行贸易。
label.en: We should trade through our portal.

label.zh: 一个未计算的变量。报告另一个[Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural]的状况！
label.en: An uncalculated variable. Report status of alternate [Root.Owner.Species.GetNamePlural]!

descriptions.zh: 我想应该和你们那边差不多。我们从[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]向太空中发展，利用新发明的曲速引擎——
descriptions.en: Much the same as it fares in your dimension, I expect. We have spread out through space from [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] since the discovery of the Warp Drive-

descriptions.zh: 在发明曲速引擎之后，[Root.Owner.Species.GetName]从[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]开始向星海进发——
descriptions.en: The [Root.Owner.Species.GetName] have spread out through space from [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] since the discovery of the Warp Drive-

label.zh: 曲速引擎？我们用的是超空间航道！
label.en: The Warp Drive? We travel by Hyperlanes!

label.zh: 错误！意外值：曲速引擎。预期值：超空间航道。
label.en: Error! Unexpected value: Warp Drive. Expected value: Hyperlanes.

descriptions.zh: 超空间航道？或许发现不同类型的超光速旅行方法，正是我们平行世界之间的分歧点？这是否意味着你们并未受到曲速兽的侵扰？
descriptions.en: Hyperlanes? Perhaps discovering different types of FTL travel was the divergence point between our two universes? Does this mean you are not beset by the Warp beasts?

descriptions.zh: **§Y处理中！§!** 结果：探索出不同类型的超光速旅行方式是我们宇宙之间的分歧点。查询：曲速兽袭击？
descriptions.en: **§YPROCESSING!§!** Results: Discovering a different type of FTL travel was the divergence point between our two universes. Query: Warp beast assault?

label.zh: 没听说过什么曲速兽。它们构成了很大的威胁吗？
label.en: No Warp beasts here. Are they a serious threat?

label.zh: 值未找到：曲速兽。查询：曲速兽威胁等级？
label.en: Value not found: Warp beasts. Query: Threat level of Warp beasts?

descriptions.zh: 曲速兽会攻击所有已知的文明。它们是所有生命之敌。据我们所知，一旦曲速旅行在星系中达到某种临界程度，曲速兽就会苏醒并攻击。已经有数个物种被它们消灭了，但目前我们还撑得住。
descriptions.en: The Warp beasts assail every known civilization, they are a threat to all life. As far as we have determined, once Warp travel reached a certain critical level in the galaxy, the Warp beasts awoke and attacked. Several species we know of have already fallen, but so far we are holding them off.

descriptions.zh: 曲速兽袭击所有已知文明，它们是所有存在的威胁。假设：一旦曲速旅行在星系中达到某种临界值，曲速兽将觉醒并攻击。数个物种已灭亡，但目前我们仍撑得住。
descriptions.en: The Warp beasts assail every known civilization, they are a threat to all existence. Hypothesis: Once Warp travel reached a certain critical level in the galaxy, the Warp beasts awoke and attacked. Several species we know of have already fallen, but so far we are holding them off.

label.zh: 听起来真可怕。我们能帮上忙吗？
查询：你是否需要物质支援？
label.en: Query: Do you require material support?

descriptions.zh: 镜像次元[Root.Owner.GetName]报告称其经济形势大好。其原因包括我们之间的传送门贸易，以及最近在对抗曲速兽时取得了一系列胜利。
descriptions.en: The Mirror-Dimension [Root.Owner.GetName] reports that their economy is booming. Contributing factors mentioned were our Portal Trade, as well as recent victories over the Warp beasts.

tooltips.zh: §Y位面传送门研究者§!产出的£amenities£和£trade_value£会提高。
tooltips.en: The £amenities£ and £trade_value£ output of §YDimensional Portal Researchers§! increases.

tooltips.zh: §Y位面传送门研究子个体§!产出的£amenities£和£energy£会提高。
tooltips.en: The £amenities£ and £energy£ output of §YDimensional Portal Drones§! increases.

descriptions.zh: 镜像次元[Root.Owner.GetName]报告称其经济最近较为萧条，原因是在对抗曲速兽时吃了一连串败仗。
descriptions.en: The Mirror-Dimension [Root.Owner.GetName] reports that their economy is in decline due to a series of defeats at the appendages of the Warp beasts.

tooltips.en: The £amenities£ and £energy£ output of §YDimensional Portal Drones§! decreases.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]已被吞噬。[Root.Owner.GetName]已陷落。据我们所知，[Root.GetName]是唯一残存的殖民地。四面八方都是曲速兽！它们来了！

**§Y信号突然中断§!**
descriptions.en:
[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] has been consumed. The [Root.Owner.GetName] has fallen. As far as we know, [Root.GetName] is the last remaining colony. The Warp beasts are everywhere! They are here!

**§YThe signal abruptly ends§!**

**§Y信号突然中断§!**
descriptions.en:
Status update: [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] offline. [Root.Owner.GetName] combat capacity: 23% of optimal. Remaining Colony network: [Root.GetName]. Expected results: Total Warp beast victory within 2 solar cycles.  Error! Warp beast activity detected in [Root.GetName] orbit! Error!

**§YThe signal abruptly ends§!**

descriptions.zh: 多年前，我们派遣[doomslayer_knight.GetName]骑士穿过[root.GetName]上的位面传送门，如今此人回来了。[doomslayer_knight.GetHeShe]形态扭曲，被黑暗笼罩，带领了一支恐怖之军穿过了传送门，立马开始袭击我们的殖民地。幸存者称他们听到[doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer]爆发出恶魔般的笑声，并宣称[doomslayer_knight.GetHeShe]将很快征服这个位面。
descriptions.en: Knight [doomslayer_knight.GetName], whom we sent through the portal on [root.GetName] years ago, has returned. Twisted and darkened, [doomslayer_knight.GetHeShe] led a host of horrors through the portal and immediately assaulted our colony. Survivors reported hearing [doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer] erupt in a demonic cackle, claiming [doomslayer_knight.GetHeShe] would soon conquer this dimension.

tooltips.zh: 传送门原址仍可供研究，但获得的数据将不如以前那般有用。
tooltips.en: The Portal site can still be studied, but it will provide less useful data.

tooltips.zh: 多支§R恶魔军队§!将袭击殖民地！
tooltips.en: Several §RDaemonic Armies§! will attack the colony!

descriptions.zh:
[doomslayer_knight.GetName]骑士从传送门中带来的恐怖大军击溃了我们的防御，征服了[fromfrom.GetName]！

被强大的异次元实体夺舍后，[doomslayer_knight.GetHimselfHerself]自号为§Y[doomslayer_knight.GetTitle][doomslayer_knight.GetName]§!，[doomslayer_knight.GetHeShe]为[doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer]召唤了一支恶魔军队，并开始征服我们的星系！

很快，恒星系的各处开始涌现出更多的传送门，但现实的织构过于厚重。所有的奇点很快就坍缩了，将恶魔的军队与它们的家园位面隔绝开。[doomslayer_knight.GetFirstName]没有受到太大影响，并开始巩固[doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer]的势力根基，以便继续[doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer]的星系征服大业。
descriptions.en:
The horrors that Knight [doomslayer_knight.GetName] led through the portal have breached our defenses and conquered [fromfrom.GetName]!

Possessed by a major dimensional being and now titling [doomslayer_knight.GetHimselfHerself] as §Y[doomslayer_knight.GetTitle] [doomslayer_knight.GetName]§!, [doomslayer_knight.GetHeShe] has called upon [doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer] demonic forces to begin the conquest of our galaxy!

Additional portals briefly opened throughout the system, but the strain on reality was too great a burden. All the singularities soon collapsed, severing the demonic host from their home dimension. Undeterred, [doomslayer_knight.GetFirstName] is now consolidating [doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer] power base before proceeding with [doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer] plans of galactic conquest.

label.zh: 我们要打败这些入侵者！

descriptions.zh: 我们数年前将[doomslayer_knight.GetName]送去[Root.GetName]上的传送门，现在这个传送门正在释放强烈的活跃信号，一些衣衫褴褛的平民似乎正试图穿越到我们的位面。他们汇报称，[doomslayer_knight.GetFirstName]骑士已经在他们的位面肆虐了十几年，无情地屠戮着任何出现在[doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer]面前的人。[doomslayer_knight.GetHeSheCap]在那个未免杀害了那么多居民，甚至对他们的社会造成了毁灭性的影响。幸存者无助地向任何能抵达的地方逃亡。难道是这个位面的痛苦使[doomslayer_knight.GetName]陷入了疯狂？
descriptions.en: The portal on [Root.GetName] where we sent Knight [doomslayer_knight.GetName] years ago is showing intense signs of activity as ragged civilians appear to be attempting to cross into our dimension. They report that Knight [doomslayer_knight.GetFirstName] has been rampaging in their dimension for a decade now, mercilessly slaughtering everyone crossing [doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer] path. [doomslayer_knight.GetHeSheCap] slew so many inhabitants of that dimension that a doom has befallen their society. The survivors are trying to flee anywhere they can. Could the existential pain caused by this dimension have driven [doomslayer_knight.GetName] to madness?

tooltips.zh: 传送门原址仍可供研究，但获得的数据将不如以前那般有用。
tooltips.en: The Portal site can still be studied, but it will provide less useful data.

descriptions.zh: 多年前，我们派遣[doomslayer_knight.GetName]骑士穿过[root.GetName]上的位面传送门，如今已经回来了。[doomslayer_knight.GetHeSheCap]历经万难，击败了无数的敌人，几乎是侥幸地保全了[doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer]的性命，但最终，没有什么能阻挡[doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer]的去路。[doomslayer_knight.GetHeSheCap]带回了许多战利品，并在扈从间成为了传说，大家开始称[doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer]为“末日杀手”。
descriptions.en: Knight [doomslayer_knight.GetName], whom we sent through the portal on [root.GetName] years ago, has returned. [doomslayer_knight.GetHeSheCap] bested many a challenge, felled countless fiends and narrowly avoided [doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer] doom, but ultimately, nothing could stand in [doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer] way. [doomslayer_knight.GetHeSheCap] brought back many trophies and has become a legend amongst the squires, who have begun calling [doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer] "Doomslayer".

label.en: [doomslayer_knight.GetFirstName] is truly brave, ferocious and gallant!

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的神秘机器人对我们的殖民者从一落足于行星上起就非常欢迎。我们的许多定居者一开始不信任这个小机器人，但它对我们建立殖民地的过程难以置信地有帮助，并且在其中扮演了重要角色。

在头几年的殖民过程中，这个小东西在[Root.GetName]上的第一座城市诞生了衍生形象，并成为了整颗行星的吉祥物。
descriptions.en:
The enigmatic creature on [Root.GetName] has been very welcoming to our colonists after they settled down on the planet. At first many of our settlers were distrustful of the small robot, but it has shown itself to be incredibly helpful and has played a key role in establishing the colony.

Following the first years of the colony, the small thing has become something of a pet figure in the first cities on [Root.GetName], and a mascot for the planet as a whole.

label.zh: 这可爱的小机器人帮助了我们真多。
label.en: How nice of the little creature to help us out.

descriptions.zh:
这座由[Root.GetName]上的小机器人监管的工厂在殖民地建立的最初几年起到了重要作用。现在这些定居者们终于得以有时间了解他们的小吉祥物以及理解它不寻常的行为，他们了解到它看护了数个世纪的这座老旧的建筑已经残破不堪，并需要比它所能提供的更多的帮助。

尽管它的远古工程和机械对我们而言仍很陌生，但我们的工程师认为他们应该可以修好，只是需要一点时间。
descriptions.en:
The factory supervised by the little robot on [Root.GetName] has been instrumental for the colony in its early years. Now that the settlers have had time to get to know their mascot and understand its uncommon mannerisms, they have learnt that the old building it has taken care of for centuries is falling apart and needs more help than the creature can give it on its own.

Though its ancient engineering and machinery are still foreign to us, our engineers think they should be able to fix it, given time.

label.zh: 那就让我们看看能不能帮上它。
label.en: Let us see if we can help it out then.

descriptions.zh: 在数年的缓慢剥蚀中，[Root.GetName]上的这座巨大工厂终于彻底瓦解。在清理完这座老建筑的废墟后，我们的殖民者发现了一个巨大的金属堆隐藏在原来建筑物中可能是地下室的位置。在它的正中央静静地躺着那个过去快乐地欢迎着我们来到这颗星球的机器人，它在这座它负责监管的工厂的倒塌过程中被压毁了。
descriptions.en: After years of slow decline, the great factory on [Root.GetName] has finally fallen apart. After clearing out all the debris from the old building, our colonists came across large piles of metal hidden away in what would have been the basement when it was still standing. In the middle of it all lies the robot that once so happily welcomed our settlers to the planet, crushed by the factory it was responsible for supervising.

descriptions.zh:
据报告，伴随着所有设备的突然停转，我们的工程师确信他们未能在[Root.GetName]上修复这座古老的工厂。由于未能找到失败的原因，他们开始放下工具离开大楼。就在这时引擎突然轰鸣起来。

不仅发动机重新工作了，而且我们的工程师似乎也意外地修复了工厂的其余部分——尽管还不清楚这是如何发生的。他们的报告最后还提到了一个小机器人，它看到工厂重新开始运作后跳起了奇怪的舞蹈。
descriptions.en:
Our engineers were certain they had failed at fixing the ancient factory on [Root.GetName], according to their report, when everything suddenly stopped. Unsure how they had managed to fail they began putting aside their tools and exiting the building, when suddenly the engine roared to life.

Not only is the engine working again, but our engineers seem to have accidentally managed to fix other parts of the factory as well - though it is unclear how that happened. Their report ends with a small description of the weird dance the little robot did when it saw its factory working again.

tooltips.zh: §Y神秘机器人§!殖民地特征现在产出§G1§!£volatile_motes£§Y易爆微粒§!和§G1§!£exotic_gases£§Y异星天然气§!。
tooltips.en: The §YEnigmatic Robot§! Colony Feature now also produces §G1§! £volatile_motes£ §YVolatile Mote§! and §G1§! £exotic_gases£ §YExotic Gas§!.

descriptions.zh:
我们收到了[Root.GetName]上的人员的报告，似乎他们行星上的神秘机器人又带来了麻烦。最近它失踪了，它失踪的同时，恰好一些殖民者被报道从该行星上的一个城市消失。

虽然这两件事最初被认为是无关的，但人们已经开始将他们朋友和家人的失踪归咎于这个机器人。我们的工程师正在扫描该机器人所在的工厂自事故发生以来收到的几个信号，看看是否这些信号能发回这个机器人。
descriptions.en:
We have received a report from the people of [Root.GetName], as it seems once again they are having trouble with the enigmatic robot on their planet. Recently it has gone missing, and its disappearance coincides with the reports of several colonists vanishing from one of the cities on the planet.

Though they were originally assumed to be unrelated, people have started blaming the creature for their missing friends and family. Our engineers are looking into scanning several signals that the robot's factory has received since the incident, to see if it leads back to the creature itself.

label.zh: 希望我们能解决这个问题，越快越好。
label.en: Let us hope we can solve this as quickly as possible.

descriptions.zh:
在花费数周尝试追踪[Root.GetName]上的机器人的信号后，我们的工程师终于发现了一座深入地下的远古竖井。在地面下的深处，他们看到了一座远古的建筑，多数的失踪人口都在锁在其中，同时还有小机器人的残留物。

在唤醒了这些殖民者之后，我们发现他们都是某个教团的成员，意外地落入了这座废墟，当小机器人来试图解救他们的时候一切都开始崩塌。我们的工程师和这些人自己都不清楚到底是怎么陷入这个地方的，也不知道是什么东西停止了建筑的崩塌。

我们的工程师对深入研究那个已经损坏的神秘机器很感兴趣，想知道能从中获得什么信息。而另一方面，[Root.GetName]的人们则期望我们可以将这个小东西修复，变回原来的样子。
descriptions.en:
After spending weeks trying to track down the signals from the robot on [Root.GetName], our engineers have finally found an ancient shaft leading deep into the ground. Far below ground they came across an ancient structure with most of the missing people locked in some form of stasis, as well as the remains of the little robot.

After waking the colonists, we learn that all of them are part of some cult that managed to accidentally make their way into the ruins, and that everything was about to collapse on them when the little robot came to their rescue. It seems unclear to both our engineers and the people themselves exactly how they found themselves in a stasis, or what the creature did to stop the collapse of the building.

Our engineers are interested in looking into the enigmatic machine now that it is no longer functional, to see what we can learn from it. The people of [Root.GetName], on the other hand, are pleading with us to see if we can restore the little creature back to its former self.

label.zh: 那就把大家的小吉祥物变回来。
label.en: Let the people have their little mascot back, then.

tooltips.zh: §Y神秘机器人§!行星特征现在额外提供一个£job_robot_caretaker£§Y机器人看护者§!岗位。
tooltips.en: The §YEnigmatic Robot§! Planetary Feature now also have a £job_robot_caretaker£ §YRobot Caretaker§! job.

label.zh: 让工程师把它拆了看看里面有什么秘密。
label.en: Have the engineers break it apart and see what mysteries it holds.

descriptions.zh: 来自[Planet.GetName]殖民地的报告显示:星球上的“返祖现象”正不断增加。显然相当一部分人口已经表现出迄今为止前所未有的性欲与攻击性，而没人知道这是为什么。
descriptions.en: Reports from our colony on [Planet.GetName] claims that there's been an increase in 'feral behavior'. Apparently parts of the population has expressed hitherto unprecedented levels of lust and aggression, and no one knows why.

descriptions.zh: [Planet.GetName]上的返祖现象没有要停止的迹象。事实上自从上次报告以来，事态愈演愈烈。滥交与暴力事件每时每刻都在发生，极大部分人口都沦陷其中。
descriptions.en: The feral behavior on [Planet.GetName] shows no signs of stopping anytime soon. In fact, it has risen since the last report. Promiscuous and violent acts happen all the time, and a large part of the population seems to be affected.

label.en: This is getting out of hand.

descriptions.zh: [Planet.GetName]上的情况正在迅速失控。不论造成这场返祖狂潮的罪魁祸首是什么，它都已经感染了惊人数量的当地居民并使得殖民地开始分崩离析。因此，我们要么开始行动，要么就会失去[Planet.GetName]。
descriptions.en: The situation on [Planet.GetName] has spiraled out of control. A staggering number of inhabitants are now infected with whatever is causing this feral deluge, and the colony has started to break down because of it. Something needs to be done, or [Planet.GetName] will be lost.

descriptions.zh:
对困扰[Planet.GetName]的奇异返祖现象的调查已经完成。我们在遍布整个地壳的洞穴隧道网络中找到了一种神秘的真菌。它长满了整个洞穴——地面，墙壁，天花板，并且蔓延了上千里。

这些真菌频繁地释放孢子排出洞穴，其目的尚不明确。但我们可以肯定正是这些孢子释放了我们物种原始的欲望并使起产生返祖现象。

我们可以为这些真菌找一个用武之地，或是干脆将其全部灭绝。
descriptions.en:
The investigation of the strange and wild behavior currently besetting [Planet.GetName] has been completed. In the vast network of cave tunnels that permeates the planet's crust an enigmatic fungus has been found. It grows all over the caves - floor, walls, ceiling - and stretches out for thousands of miles.

The fungus frequently releases spores that are vented out of the caves - for what purpose has not been established, but we know for certain that it causes primitive behavior in our species, releasing primal urges within.

We can try to find a useful application of this phenomenon, or we can exterminate the fungus altogether.

descriptions.zh:
大批工业设备在生长真菌的洞穴系统出口处建造起来。除了过滤并控制这些孢子的传播以外，这些工厂也能将多余的孢子云转化为有用的§H异星天然气§!。

由于[Planet.GetName]上有点饥渴的当地居民更频繁地满足自己的性欲，人口增长速率得以提高。与此同时不幸的是[Planet.GetName]的暴力行为也将更为频繁。
descriptions.en:
Industrial facilities have been built over the outlets for the fungus-infested cave systems. Apart from filtering and regulating the spread of spores, these plants can also convert any excess spore clouds into useful §Hexotic gases§!.

The population growth is increased as the somewhat randy inhabitants of [Planet.GetName] satisfy their urges more frequently, which unfortunately also means that the level of violence and conflict is somewhat higher on [Planet.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
将洞穴蘑菇彻底燃尽的计划现在已经完成，这些激发原始冲动的菌类现在已经被彻底铲除。

碰巧的是，许多被清理过后的洞穴被发现原来潜藏着高品质的矿脉，现在也可以被我们更加妥善地利用了。
descriptions.en:
The project to incinerate all Cave Mushrooms have now been completed and the primal urge-inducing fungus has been exterminated.

As luck would have it, several of the burned-out caves turned out to have rich mineral veins, which can now be exploited further.

descriptions.zh: 一处[Root.GetName]上的地理学异常现象引起了我们的注意。一个采矿设施周围突然出现了碗状的凹地，随后我们对此展开了调查。这个凹地的特征几乎从未在冰川区以外的地方发现过，但奇怪的是：当暴露在某些电磁波段时，这个“圆凹地”的侧壁会产生共振，并且会产生花瓣状的可见光散射。调查正在进行。
descriptions.en: A geological anomaly has come to our attention on [Root.GetName]. We began surveying after a bowl-shaped depression suddenly appeared alongside a mining facility there. Features like this are almost never found outside of a glacial region, but stranger still: the walls of this 'cirque' scatter visible light in a flower-petal pattern, and have been found to resonate when exposed to certain electro-magnetic bands. Investigations are ongoing.

descriptions.zh:
我们的科学家报告称，这些在[Root.GetName]新发现的蓝色晶状物质对延迟擦除光子能量响应剧烈。这些矿物将光子的波长过滤，并反射了一道可以将普通的硅化物转化为新型超导合金的光束——尽管只有在日光下才能进行。

由于该过程涉及到在一个狭小空间内反射高能辐射，若干科学家已经提出异议。而另一群热血沸腾的研究者则提出了相反的意见，他们强调这种现象可以彻底变革我们精练贵金属的方式。但无论如何：进一步开发这项科技都需要巨大的投入。
descriptions.en:
Our scientists report that the newly-uncovered, crystalline blue deposits on [Root.GetName] respond dramatically to delayed-erasure photon energy. The minerals filter its wavelengths and reflect a beam which is capable of transforming ordinary silicates into a new, super-conductive alloy - though only ever during daylight.

Given that this process essentially involves bouncing high levels of radiation around an enclosed space, some scientists have already come out in protest. A different group of excited researchers offers a counter-argument, stressing that this phenomenon could revolutionize the way we refine precious metals. Either way: developing this technique further will be costly.

descriptions.zh:
在[Root.GetName]的盆地中发现了一台运行着独立程序的离群的无人机。受到改进我们矿物冶炼方式的初始指令驱动，它找到了一种将硅化物转化为新种类合金的方法。

这一过程似乎涉及将高能束从特征墙中的矿物质反射回来。该无人机孜孜不觉的工作似乎导致了这一区域被填满了高能辐射。因此该无人机被捕获，而究竟是重新整合进系统还是将其个体摧毁从而获取相关知识有待决定。
descriptions.en:
A rogue drone has been found running its own project within the cirque on [Root.GetName]. Driven by its initial directive - to refine our methods of mineral extraction - it has since stumbled onto a means of transforming everyday silicates into a new type of alloy.

The process seems to involve bouncing high-energy beams off mineral deposits in the feature's wall. The drone's eagerness in its task has caused it to flood the area with excessive levels of radiation. It has therefore been isolated pending either re-integration, or destruction of its individuality and acquired knowledge.

label.en: Bring it back into the fold.

label.zh: 让我们瞧瞧这项研究会带来什么。
label.en: Let's see where this research goes.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]上呈现出令人遗憾的场景，一群过于痴狂的科学家在计划的最后关头横加干涉。由于被自己的研究所迷醉，他们以“为了新科学”的名义试图夺取嬗变实验的控制权。引发的斗殴导致了设备的损坏，继而造成了无法控制的连锁反应。

最后在盆地中残存下来的是一个近乎晶洞的结构：岩质的外壳中包覆着由原来构成仪器设备和反对者们的物质转变而成的晶体。
descriptions.en:
Regrettable scenes on [Root.GetName], as a group of obsessive scientists sought to intervene in the project's closure. Dazzled by their own research, they attempted to wrest control of the transmutation experiments 'for the benefit of new science.' The resulting scuffle caused equipment to be damaged, and a runaway cascade took hold.

What remains of the cirque is something akin to a geode: a rocky shell around what used to be the equipment and protestors, now re-rendered in crystalline form.

descriptions.zh: 那个迷途的无人机和它的发现被彻底地抹除了。现在其意外的实验成果也仅是一片混乱，少量有用的物质被收集了起来。
descriptions.en: The wayward drone and its findings have been successfully purged. The results of its fluke experiments now litter the landscape; a small amount of useful material has been reclaimed.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]上的实验室得出了可靠的结果。虽然目前这一过程只能将少量的岩石转化成合金，但研究者对更大规模的操作抱有高度的信心。他们请求获得更多的资源。
descriptions.en: The laboratory on [From.GetName] is yielding verifiable results. Although their process can still only transmute small amounts of rock into alloys, researchers have high hopes for a larger-scale operation. They have requested access to further resources.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]上凶险的实验得出了结果。虽然这一过程目前仍只能将少量物质转化为这种新金属，但该实验非常可靠。可能需要委以更多专项研究工作。
descriptions.en: The rogue experiments on [Root.GetName] are yielding results. Although the process can still only transmute small amounts of matter into this new metal, the experiment is now verifiable. This could warrant more dedicated research efforts.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]上的嬗变实验失败了，然而这一失败也避免了未来更大灾难的发生。当这种新型的设备刚一上线时，在设定的容忍限度内其表现良好。然而当对其发出关闭指令时，该过程会突然加速并达到故障保护极限。随后设施的外壳发生了转化，周围的物质全部变为了一种相同的超导合金。

该过程发生的地面爆炸夺去了许多生命，并且摧毁了周围的区域。从中我们只能获取一层有用物质，和一个无法解明的事故教训。
descriptions.en:
The transmutation experiments at [From.GetName] have failed - though their failure may actually have prevented future catastrophe. When new, more refined equipment was first brought online, it ran well within design tolerances. However, when shut-down instructions were issued, the process accelerated beyond the reach of its failsafes. Conversion took hold in the facility's housing, transmuting it and its surroundings into the same, super-conductive alloy.

The resulting ground explosion has taken a number of lives along with significant chunks of the surrounding landscape. We're left with little other than a seam of good material, and a cautionary tale in metaphysics.

descriptions.zh: 我们下一阶段的实验性生产设施上线了。以“蓝荷”命名的晶体嬗变设施现在正在夜以继日将前所未有规模的基础材料转化为有用的合金。
descriptions.en: The next phase of our experimental production facility has come online. The Blue Lotus crystalline transmutation facility is now busy converting unprecedented amounts of base material into useful alloys.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]上的实验性设施发生了灾难性的失败。操作员说，我们可能永远也无法查明到底是什么导致了安全壳的失效，结果是整个设施、包括建筑物和周围的一大片区域都被失控的嬗变反应转变成了同一种超导合金。于此可以发掘出大量的有用材料。
descriptions.en: A catastrophic failure has occurred at the experimental facility on [Root.GetName]. Operatives say we may never know what specifically caused the failure in containment, but the result was runaway transmutation of the equipment, its housing, and a vast chunk of the surrounding landscape - all into the same, superconductive alloy. A rich seam of this material is all that remains.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]遇到了奇怪的情况：我们显然定居到了某种巨大的两栖爬行动物身上，他们的骨质外壳由多种奇特的矿物构成。许多我们认为是当地岛屿的其实都是这种生物，我们的殖民者则将他们称为“§Y尼玛§!”。

他们看起来人畜无害，由于我们并没有深入他们的外壳，他们应该几乎没注意到我们。
descriptions.en:
Our colony on [Root.GetName] has encountered an odd situation: we have apparently settled on the back of a gargantuan amphibian reptile, whose bony shell is formed of various exotic minerals. Most of what we thought were local islands have turned out to be these creatures; our colonists have begun to refer to them as '§YNemmas§!'.

They seem harmless enough, and as long as we don't dig too deep into their shell, they should barely notice us.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]的殖民地正在繁荣发展，这个新殖民地的青少年当然要为自己创造一些娱乐，就像所有年轻人都会做的一样。一个团体发明了一种互相比拼悄悄接近当地尼玛头部的游戏。

不幸的是，这一大胆的行动导致了悲剧：在惊吓到了这只巨兽之后，一些年轻的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]从这只巨大生物的颈部坠落，造成多名人口受伤，其中一位不治身亡。

烦躁的殖民者现在要求实施一些举措来应对这些“残暴的巨兽”。
descriptions.en:
As our colony at [Root.GetName] has been flourishing, the adolescents of this new world have sought to create entertainment for themselves - as youths are wont to do. Some groups have made a game of sneaking up as close as they dare to their local Nemma's head.

Unfortunately, this daring activity has led to tragedy: after startling the beast, several young [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] fell off the neck of the massive creature, resulting in injuries and one fatality.

Distraught colonists are now asking for something to be done about these "brutish behemoths."

descriptions.zh:
在我们在[Root.GetName]的殖民地繁荣发展时，显然尼玛对我们前往其头部的无人机感到非常地不适。特别是在这只野兽畏缩并从它的脖子上甩下了许多[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，造成明显损失时尤为明显。

如果不进行一些举措处理这些巨兽我们的进展将会受到影响。
descriptions.en:
While our [Root.GetName] colony has been flourishing, it has become apparent that Nemmas have a strong aversion to our drones venturing near their head. This became starkly apparent when one such beast flinched and dislodged several [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] from its neck, causing severe damage.

Our progress will be restrained unless we do something to handle these behemoths.

label.zh: 让这些年轻人玩儿去吧。

descriptions.zh:
派遣我们最好的生物学家和工程师为[Root.GetName]上的尼玛困境寻找潜在的解决方案，许多提案现已经完成可以呈交。

我们考虑了从最普通到最极端的所有想法。这一情况的紧迫程度要求我们直接跳到现场调研查中。
descriptions.en:
Having tasked our best biologists and engineers with devising potential solutions for the Nemma dilemma on [Root.GetName], several proposals are now ready to be presented.

We've considered everything from the most rational to the most extreme of ideas. The urgency of this situation demands we must skip straight to live field tests.

label.zh: 繁育更多尼玛，并保护他们的安全以获得更多生存空间。
label.en: Breed more Nemmas and safeguard them for more living space.

label.zh: 奴役这些尼玛，让他们为我们所用。
label.en: Enslave the Nemmas so that they become deferential and compliant.

label.zh: 够了！摁住这些尼玛，钻取他们的外壳。
label.en: Enough! Sedate the Nemmas, and start drilling their shells.

descriptions.zh: 在一些对成年个体的初步试验之后，我们的动物学家已经在[Root.GetName]上设立了一个尼玛繁育系统，以期为海洋带来更多的巨大尼玛。繁育者提示，这不可能无限地进行下去，因为这颗行星只能再承载额外三只或者四只尼玛。我们得到下一只尼玛的时间大约需要§Y十年§!。
descriptions.en: After initial trials with the adult specimen, our zoologists have set up a Nemma breeding system on [Root.GetName] in the hopes of introducing more giant Nemmas to our oceans. The breeders warn that this cannot continue indefinitely, and that the planet can only support three, perhaps four more Nemmas. The estimated time until we have our next Nemma should be about §Yten years§!.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]上的繁育计划结出了硕果，另一只尼玛加入了我们的行列！这个幼年个体很快适应了我们的存在，而我们发现它是一座稳定的栖息地。这只尼玛现在已经准备好承载我们的产业了。

然而，由于已经达到了生态承载上限，这将会是这个星球上最后一只新增的尼玛。我们的牧尼玛人必须在繁育尼玛之外寻找新的着力点，就是说他们需要更好地维护已有的尼玛。
descriptions.en:
Our breeding program on [Root.GetName] bears fruit as we add another Nemma to our ranks! This juvenile has quickly acclimated to our presence, and we have found it a stable habitat. The Nemma should now be ready to bear our industry.

This will, however, have to be the last Nemma added to this world, as their habitat has reached capacity. Our Nemma wranglers will have to refocus their efforts not on breeding more Nemmas, but instead on maintaining what they already have created.

descriptions.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上的繁育计划结出了硕果，另一只尼玛加入了我们的行列！这个幼年个体很快适应了我们的存在，而我们发现它是一座稳定的栖息地。这只尼玛现在已经准备好承载我们的产业了。
descriptions.en: Our breeding program on [Root.GetName] bears fruit as we add another Nemma to our ranks! This juvenile has quickly acclimated to our presence, and we have found it a stable habitat. The Nemma should now be ready to bear our industry.

label.zh: 叹为观止！能再表演一遍那个吗！

descriptions.zh: 难过的是我们最近尝试在[Root.GetName]增添另一只尼玛的努力失败了；我们无法为这么巨大的生物寻找到足够的栖息空间。但[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]并没有沮丧，并且承诺未来会取得更好的结果。
descriptions.en: Sadly the latest effort to add another Nemma to [Root.GetName] has failed; we could find no habitat spacious enough for such a massive beast to thrive. The [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are not dismayed, however, and promise better results in the future.

descriptions.zh:
我们的外星生物工程师[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]成功驯服了尼玛威胁！由于我们不懈的努力，这些生命现在向我们臣服了。

这些尼玛获得了新的用途：最高级的驮畜。他们庞大的躯体使得他们可以搭载难以计量的材料，由神经植入体引导选择最优的路线。我们的殖民活动也由此得到了加速。
descriptions.en:
Our xeno-bioengineering [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] have curtailed the Nemma menace! Thanks to our superb efforts, the creatures are now subservient to us.

The Nemmas have been granted renewed purpose as superlative beasts of burden. Their colossal bulk allows them to carry immense quantities of materiel, guided down optimal routes by way of their cybernetic implants. Our colonization effort has accelerated accordingly.

label.zh: 棒极了，现在我们可以开始干点正事了。
label.en: Excellent work, now our true work can begin.

descriptions.zh:
今天在[Root.GetName]上爆发了一些骚乱，部分人口奋起抗议我们对尼玛的对待方式。这些抗议者在围着尼玛的头部也就是殖民首府的所在地排成了人墙。抗议者要求我们立刻将尼玛放归自由，并致力维系这些物种而不是奴役他们。

这一运动很快扩散到了其他尼玛身上的其他地方——然而，利于我们目前计划的反抗议也在形成，公共矛盾逐渐升级，并有爆发出暴力冲突的危险。
descriptions.en:
Today riots broke out on [Root.GetName] as parts of the population have risen in protest against our treatment of the Nemmas. The protestors formed a picket line around the head of the Nemma on which the colony's capital lies. The protestors demanded that we immediately set all the Nemmas free, working to conserve their species rather than enslave them.

The movement has quickly spread to sites around the other Nemmas - however, counter-protests have formed in favor of our existing programs, escalating public tension and risking outbursts of violence.

label.zh: 逮捕煽动者然后让他们去扫大街。
label.en: Arrest the instigators and put them on waste disposal duty.

descriptions.zh: 我们的工程师和生化学家实现了自我超越。新开发的药物和极度精确的钻头让我们可以在不威胁到我们基础设施的前提下通过钻入这些尼玛的坚硬晶质外壳中获取矿物，同时还能获取生物质。我们所有的殖民地中只有这里可以产出这样的资源。
descriptions.en: Our engineers and biochemists have outdone themselves. Newly developed drugs and extremely precise drills will allow us to harvest the minerals by drilling into the hard crystalline shell of these Nemmas, as well as allowing us to collect biomatter from beneath without jeopardizing our infrastructure. If only all our colonies could yield such bounties.

titles.zh: 消灭这些长寿的爬行动物

descriptions.zh: 对尼玛的净化已经完成了——极度地系统化，因此既没有污染海洋也没有威胁到我们的基础设施。很快我们可以将我们的注意力转移到收获它们的尸骸中，并在[Root.GetName]上建立更多的永久殖民地。首先，我们得先储存好这些残羹剩饭。
descriptions.en: The purging of the Nemmas has been completed - all very systematically, so as not to pollute the oceans or otherwise endanger our infrastructure. Soon we can turn our attention to the task of harvesting their remains, and establishing a more permanent and enduring colony on [Root.GetName]. First, however, we need to store all the leftovers.

label.zh: 这是对待这些无脑野兽的最佳方法。
label.en: The only way to handle such mindless beasts.

descriptions.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上的地质勘探揭示了这颗行星远比我们之前预想的更加富有矿藏。在调节了我们的传感器以后它便可以扫描更深的地下，发现了许多大有前景的矿场。我们应该委派更多的人力物力进行勘探，或许可以发现更深处的有用矿脉。
descriptions.en: Geological surveys on [Root.GetName] have revealed that the planet is richer in minerals than we thought. After calibrating our sensors to penetrate deeper into the ground, we have discovered several promising mining sites. Should we direct additional resources to probing efforts, we might yet uncover deeper veins of useful ore.

options.script:
name = colony.9050.a
add_deposit = d_ore_rich_caverns

label.zh: 批准经费，进行深层勘探。

descriptions.zh: 探测[Root.GetName]的地下是一个冗长的过程：我们的探测器对地下构成的响应不佳，地质构造中的断层又使得我们需要频繁地调整仪器。然而，我们还是发现了更多值得开发的高价值矿石。它们的深度使得开采作业的后勤工作远复杂于往常，但无论如何这应该都是值得的。没有迹象表明进一步的了勘探作业可以让我们找到更多矿脉了。
descriptions.en: Probing the underground of [Root.GetName] is a tedious process: our scanners do not react well to the ground composition, and shifts in the geological layers mean that we have to recalibrate them every time. Still, we have discovered more exploitable veins of high quality ore. Their depths makes the logistics of the mining operation more complex than usual, but it will take more than that to stop us. There is no assurance that additional probing operations will lead us to more mineral veins.

descriptions.zh: 最近在[Root.GetName]的勘探作业几乎一无所获。我们所能找到的其他的矿藏全部都埋藏过深、储量不大，而且处于不稳定的地层当中。开采这些矿物的成本将会高于开采所得的利润。尽管如此，我们此前的发现已经表明此处的资源极其丰富，我们需要数十年乃至上百年的时间才能开发完毕。
descriptions.en: The latest prospecting efforts on [Root.GetName] were inconclusive. Whatever minerals we could detect were buried too deep, in too small quantities, and through unstable ground. The projected costs of exploiting these veins would be higher than the profits. Despite this, our previous findings represents an enormous source of resources that should keep us busy for decades if not centuries.

descriptions.zh: 无论在[Root.GetName]上的矿物藏得多深，我们都要找到它们，开采它们。我们一直就是这样的。其他人也许面对不稳定地层、令人望而却步的深度和采矿运输的后勤工作面前退缩，而我们绝不。底下世界就是我们的家园，只要找准方向定能有所收获。往下挖得越深，矿物的品质和储量就越高。我们最新的采样甚至表明了深层中稀有水晶的存在。
descriptions.en: No matter how deep the minerals on [Root.GetName] are hidden, we will find and extract them. It is what we do. Others might give up when confronted with unstable grounds, unfathomable depths or the logistics of maintaining transport tunnels, but we do not. The underground is our home, and if we know where to look, it will provide. The lower we go, the higher the quality and quantity of the ore. Our latest samples even hinted at the presence of rare crystals deeper.

label.zh: 我们已经找到够多了，开始开采吧。

descriptions.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上的勘探队已经抵达了最新的深度。如预期一样，灯光所及之处，我们果然找到了一丛丛闪耀着橙色、黄色和红色的灵动光芒的晶簇。它们有的看起来如同照亮洞穴的火盆，在岩壁上投下斑驳的光影。我们还有一个谜一样的发现：如果以千年尺度来观测，这些晶体似乎在缓慢地向行星的地心移动。我们相信，如果向地心挖得更深的话我们一定会有更多发现。
descriptions.en: A new depth has been reached by our surveying expeditions on [Root.GetName]. As predicted, we are encountering clusters of crystals that shine in vivid hues of oranges, yellows, and reds when light passes through them. At times, it looks as if a brazier is illuminating the caves where we find them, casting shifting shadows on the walls. We also made a puzzling observation: it looks as if over the millennia, these crystals are slowly migrating towards the center of the planet. We are confident that there will be more to find if only we dig deeper towards the core.

label.zh: 这些勘探工作花销过高了。
label.en: These probing works are too expensive.
Then a digging we shall go.

descriptions.zh:
我们的勘探队往[Root.GetName]的深处进一步寻找矿石的过程中发现越来越多的水晶散布在他们的路径上。最终，他们抵达了接近[Root.GetName]核心的一个巨大洞穴，随后便失去了联系。他们最后的消息是正在搭建灯光和传感器以研究洞穴，然后就听到痛苦的尖叫，死亡和毁灭随之而来。

事故的原因很快被确定了，其他的地址勘探者探测到了多重的隧道回声正高速向我们的殖民地袭来。没过多久，恐怖的事情发生了，我们被一个硕大无比的晶态实体袭击。它看起来太空中的晶态实体别无二致，但更加具有侵略性，并且可以使用重构能力在一瞬间改变它们的身体形状。

以前我们用来安抚太空晶体的无线电信号都没有起作用。尽管晶态实体的核心还深埋于地下，但它分裂出许多触手一般的附肢正在破土而出，准备攻击我们同时吸收更多晶体生长。预期前景十分不妙，我们很快就能看到到[Root.GetName]上的殖民活动要到头了。
descriptions.en:
As our surveyors delved ever deeper to find ore on [Root.GetName], more and more crystals littered their paths. Finally, they reached a gigantic cavern located close to the core of [Root.GetName], and we lost communications. The last thing we know is that they were in the process of setting up lights and various sensors to study the cave. Then screams. Pain. Death. Destruction.

The cause was soon revealed when other geological surveyors detected multiple echoes tunneling at tremendous speed toward our colonies. Not long after, amid quakes and tremors, we were attacked by a crystalline entity of tremendous proportions. It is not unlike the spaceborne crystals, but seems to be highly aggressive, and capable of using the reconstructive capabilities of its kind to reshape its body in an instant.

 All attempts to deploy the radio signals that we use to pacify spaceborne crystals have failed. While the core of the crystalline entity remain buried deep, it spawned tentacle-like appendages that dug through the ground looking to attack us or to absorb more crystals to grow. Projections are grim and we might be looking at the end of our colony on [Root.GetName].

Finally, they reached a gigantic cavern located close to the core of [Root.GetName], and we lost communications. The last thing we know is that they were in the process of setting up lights and various sensors to study the cave. Then screams. Pain. Death. Destruction.

The cause was soon revealed when other geological surveyors detected multiple echoes tunneling at tremendous speed toward our colonies. Not long after, amid quakes and tremors, we were attacked by a crystalline entity of tremendous proportions. While the core of the crystalline entity remain buried deep, it spawned tentacle-like appendages that dug through the ground looking to attack us or to absorb more crystals to grow. Projections are grim and we might be looking at the end of our colony on [Root.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 经过精疲力竭的斗争，盘踞于行星核心的晶态实体终于被击败了。最终的决战发生在深层地下，这只晶体巨兽核心的巢穴当中，只有将其击碎才能彻底停止它的活动。它的诸多附肢瓦解了，在分子层面发生了分解，在整个行星上散播着晶体尘埃。晶体的触手钻出的无数隧道将让我们在挖取构成这颗行星深层的富矿获得巨大的便利。至于这个晶态实体的起源我们仍还有诸多未解之谜，但我们也对太空中的晶体是如何创造出来的获得了一些见解。
descriptions.en: After a grueling campaign, the crystalline entity dwelling at the heart of a planet has finally been defeated. The final battle took place deep underground, in the cave housing the core of the crystal behemoth, and only after we managed to shatter it did the beast stop fighting. Its various appendages disintegrated, losing cohesion at a molecular level and sprinkling crystal dust across the planet. The innumerable tunnels left in the wake of crystal tentacles are going to help us a lot in our efforts to mine the exceptionally rich minerals composing this world. As for the origin of the entity itself, we are left with many questions, but we might have just gained some insight on the way that spacefaring crystalline entities are created.

descriptions.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上的开采作业遇到了意外的困难，包括一些小规模的地震和晶体矿脉的位移，总之发生了一些什么奇怪的事情。穷尽我们所有关于开采的经验都无法解释到底是怎么回事。这些情况使得我们很难保证开采作业的安全，我们已经在一些无法预测的事故和塌方中损失了一些设备、人员和矿石。也许我们应该适可而止，在一定的深度停止采矿。
descriptions.en: Our mining operations on [Root.GetName] have encountered unexpected difficulties. Ranging from mild tremors to shifting crystal veins, something is going on. Despite all our experience in tunneling, we have no idea what it is. These circumstances make it hard to work in secure conditions, and we have already lost gear, lives and ore in unpredictable accidents and collapses. Perhaps it would be best to halt mining operations under a certain depth?

descriptions.zh:
在一次对[Root.GetName]的例行探索中，行星探索单位发现了一座巨大的大门，其后很可能具有整座大山规模的内部空间。看来是其中隐形装置发出的某种强磁场导致飞船的探测器没有发现这里，而伪装过的大门也让使其对地表测绘探测器隐形了。

另一方面，更专门的测试显示，向其输入稳定的能量流应该可以让大门重新激活，最终也让我们得以一窥其后的秘密。
descriptions.en:
During a standard reconnaissance of [Root.GetName], the planetary exploration unit came across a massive door that apparently leads directly into the interior of a mountain range. It appears that the strong magnetic field produced by some sort of cloaking device hid it from our ship's sensors, and the camouflaged entrance remained invisible to the autonomous research probes mapping the surface.

On the other hand, more specialized tests have shown that delivering a steady stream of energy should make the door operational again, eventually allowing us to open it and see what's inside.

tooltips.zh: 建起供电网络需要花费一些时间，并且会在探索地下舱室的过程中持续地消耗能量。
tooltips.en: Setting up the grid might take some time, and will continue to sip the energy during the exploration of the vault.

descriptions.zh: 能量从电路中流过，大门再一次被激活，经过简单的修修补补我们很快明白了大门的工作原理。进一步的拓扑研究揭示了其内部是一个巨大的地下舱室。墙上的每一寸都覆盖着外星基础设施，甚至包括支撑天花板的巨大支柱也释放出若隐若现的能量信号。由于能量读数和与我们科技的模糊相似性，这似乎是一座地下的生产设施。
descriptions.en: As energy flowed through the circuits, the entrance came online, and with additional tinkering, we quickly discovered how the door worked. Additional topographical research revealed the interior to be a large underground vault. Alien infrastructure covered every square centimeter of the walls - even the huge pillars supporting the ceiling showed faint energy signatures. Given the energy readings and vague similarities to our technology, it appears to be an underground manufacturing facility.

label.zh: 我们会研究其中的秘密。

tooltips.zh: 由于该工程规模浩大，彻底研究它将花费许多资源、人力以及不可预估的时间。预计会就这项工程的进展进行周期性汇报。
tooltips.en: Given the scope of this operation, it will take a lot of resources, workforce, and an unknown amount of time to study it thoroughly. Regular updates and reports on their work are somewhat to be expected.

label.zh: 我们不能冒这个险，安放炸药。
label.en: We can't risk it, place explosives.

tooltips.zh: 我们将封闭入口，并炸毁这个地方。没人知道在地下舱室里到底是会有什么东西在等着我们。
tooltips.en: We will seal the entrance and demolish this place. Who knows what might lurk inside this vault.

descriptions.zh:
距离地下舱室很远的人也能感受到大地在震颤，而近一些的人甚至可以看到硕大的山体碎块飞向空中，在地上产生了一个巨大无比的凹坑，其中散布着岩石、碎片和扭曲的机械部件。关于到底发生了什么事情，有一个很简单的猜测，在试图通过爆破炸毁大门的时候，设施内发生了一系列连锁反应。

不论如何，这座地下舱室最终只剩下这个冒着烟的大弹坑了。
descriptions.en:
Those far from the vault could feel the ground shake. Those closer could see a large chunk of the mountainside fly off into the air, creating a huge crater filled with rocks, debris, and twisted machinery. A quick guess as to what could have gone wrong led to the conclusion that a chain reaction was set in motion inside the vault when the initial explosion breached the door.

Regardless, a smoking crater is all that is left of the underground vault.

descriptions.zh:
研究[Root.GetName]的第一阶段主要关注对入口的测绘。地下舱室的第一个房间是一个巨大的直深入山体的大厅，分支的走廊则又通向更深处。石雕的柱子上装饰着许多华丽的牌匾，每一块上面都描绘着可能是建造这座设施的外星种族。我们无法破译他们的语言，但由这些图画记叙的故事都以战争、纷争和奇迹般的工程为主体。

更恼人的是有一整个建设单位失踪了；他们在汇报了黑暗中发出的某种声响之后就消失得无影无踪。局势有一发不可收拾的风险，需要更多果断举措。
descriptions.en:
The initial phase of research on [Root.GetName] was largely focused on mapping the entrance. The first room within the vault is a giant hall, stretching deep into the mountain, with several branching corridors pushing even further into the depths. Various ornate plaques decorate stone chiseled pillars, each depicting the alien race that presumably built this place. We can't decipher their language, but the story told by those art pieces are centered on warfare, struggle, and grandiose projects.

More disturbing is the loss of an entire construction unit; after reporting the presence of strange sounds in the dark, the unit simply vanished. The situation is in danger of slipping out of control and calls for more decisive action.

label.zh: 增派安保力量并搜救他们。
label.en: Double the security forces and search for them.

tooltips.zh: 我们会组建一支搜救团队，但许多居民已经料到了最坏的可能。我们还会增派安保人手以避免这种情况再次发生。
tooltips.en: We will form a search team, but a lot of citizens already anticipate the worst. We will also double the guards to prevent further incidents.

label.zh: 不惜一切代价找到他们！

tooltips.zh: 我们不能放任他们不管！我们要组建一支志愿队搜寻失踪者！
tooltips.en: We can't leave them to die! We will make a volunteer squad to look for the missing!

label.zh: 组建搜寻队，让其他人继续工作。
label.en: Form a search party, and put the rest back to work.

tooltips.zh: 可以预见这样的事情可能还会再次发生。我们会尝试找到失踪的工人，但是行动不能拖延，我们已经做好了牺牲的准备。
tooltips.en: It was expected that something like this might have happened. We will try to find the missing workers, but we can't delay our operations - we are ready to pay the price.

label.zh: 令人不安。派遣更多安保子个体。

tooltips.zh: 失踪的单位会有新的顶替上去，研究要继续。
tooltips.en: Missing units will be replaced with new ones. The research has to continue.

descriptions.zh:
我们的一支安保队伍汇报他们找到了失踪的工人。看来这个地下舱室中用于将不速之客关进“小盒子”的陷阱和装置还在运作中，这些设施由可以自行移动的墙体组成。

那些不走运的工人被陷阱杀害了。我们的民众对结果非常愤怒，但至少我们知道该留心什么东西了。
descriptions.en:
One of our security teams reports that the missing workers have been found. It turns out that this vault still has operational traps and devices that were programmed to trap unwanted visitors within "boxes" comprised of dislocated and moving walls.

The unfortunate workers were all killed within the trap. Our citizenry is furious at the result, but at least now we know what to look for.

descriptions.zh: 在派出了大量的搜救团队之后，我们很快就找到了失踪的工人。发现他们的时候，他们正被关在一个立方体牢房一样的结构中，这似乎是由自由移动的墙体构成的。看来地下舱室中的安保系统还在运作，因此，我们之后会更小心地应对这些陷阱装置。尽管如此，人们还是对工人起初没有得到妥善保护而感到愤怒。
descriptions.en: Given the enormous search team, it didn't take long to find the missing workers. The last of them were discovered trapped in a square prison-like structure made of articulated and self-moving walls. It appears that the security systems within the vault are still operational. Given this, we will be more prepared to counter such contraptions in the future. Nonetheless, the population is angry that the workers were not provided with proper safety measures in the first place.

descriptions.zh: 失踪的工人在一处怪异的陷阱装置中找到了，他们被四面可移动的墙体困在了里面。不幸的是这些个体已经不再对帝国有什么用处了，但至少他们的牺牲揭示了陷阱的存在。现在工作可以继续畅通无阻地进行，而在这里工作的人们心里的石头也落地了，他们知道自己至少现在是安全了。
descriptions.en: The missing workers were found in a grotesque contraption that imprisoned them between four movable walls. Unfortunately, these individuals are no longer of any use to the empire, but at least their sacrifice revealed the existence of the trap. The work now continues undisturbed, and the population working on the site feels some relief, knowing that they should be safe - for now.

label.zh: 他们早就知道这其中的危险。

descriptions.zh: 失踪的子个体在一处由可动墙体构成的精巧的陷阱装置中找到了，它们可以互相勾连形成密闭空间。不幸的是这些子个体都已经过度损坏、不堪再用。之后我们的调查子个体就可以利用这些知识来对抗同类陷阱了。工作得以不受干扰地继续进行下去。
descriptions.en: The missing drones were found in an ingenious contraption of moving walls that linked together to create enclosed prison spaces. Unfortunately, all of our drones are damaged beyond use. From now on, our surveying drones will use this knowledge to neutralize traps of this kind. Work continues without any further disturbances.

descriptions.zh: 我们对[Root.GetName]通道的探索发现了一座大堂，奇怪的是这个房间并不像所有其他的一样密布着机械和管道。看起来建造者对这里特别用心，其中安放着许多保存良好的双足动物雕塑。这些雕塑具有一定的细节，但大多具有统一的外观。不幸的是，除了对可能是历史人物的一些纪念性致敬之外，没有证据表明这个大厅有什么作用。
descriptions.en: We delved into the corridors at [Root.GetName] and discovered a large hall, which is strangely devoid of the pipe machines covering every other hallway and wall. It looks like whoever built this place took special care of it - there are many statues here in excellent condition, depicting bipedal individuals. With some traces of detail they have mostly a uniform appearance. Unfortunately, there is no evidence of what this hall was, other than some monumental tribute to probably historical figures.

tooltips.zh: 这就是一些没用的陈旧艺术作品，没什么价值。
tooltips.en: It's just a useless piece of old art, with no real value.

tooltips.zh: 我们的一些工匠对这些外星人的作品赞不绝口。他们在这些艺术中找到了远古之美与和谐的启迪。
tooltips.en: Some of our craftsmen are astonished by the work created by those aliens. They find a hint of old beauty and harmony in their art.

tooltips.zh: 我们的人民发现这些石雕实在是精美绝伦，在这样一个陌生的地方发现如此绝品真是令人欣慰。
tooltips.en: Our people find the stonework to be of absolutely extraordinary quality, which is very soothing to find in such an unfamiliar place.

tooltips.zh: 这个地方仿佛就是由我们自己最好的石匠和艺术家打造而成的，难道仅仅是巧合吗？
tooltips.en: This place looks almost like the work made by our greatest stonemasons and artificers. Is this a mere coincidence?

descriptions.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]的地震探测器发现了一场即将到来的地震。虽然大部分工人安全无虞，但其中一组在深处舱室的工人可能遭遇塌方的危险。他们汇报称有两台不一样的远古机器，一台是连接到地面的笨重装置，另一台则通过一系列管道连接到墙体上。我们暂不清楚哪一台对这处设施更加重要。工人们估计他们可以拆解其中一台机器用于加固墙体和天花板以应对地震。
descriptions.en: Our seismographs have detected an impending earthquake on [Root.GetName]. Most of the workers have found safety, but one group is in a remote hall that could be at risk of collapse. They reported two distinct, ancient machines there - one being a bulky contraption connected to the ground, and the other attached to the walls via a series of pipes. We can't say if they are anything important for the facility. The workers have estimated that may be possible to use one of those machines to reinforce the ceiling and walls against the quake.

label.zh: 那就用那台笨重的东西。

descriptions.zh: 我们的工人拆解了机器，并成功地巩固了承重结构和天花板。然而，在这之后墙体暴露出了更多的管道，从中逸出嘶嘶声。目前我们无法评估潜在的损失。
descriptions.en: Our workers managed to disassemble the machinery and have successfully bolstered the strength of the supports and ceiling. However, this effort exposed extensive piping in the walls, from which a hissing noise escapes. Right now, it's impossible to assess the potential losses.

descriptions.zh: 我们的工人拆解了机器，并成功地巩固了承重结构和天花板。不过代价到底是什么呢？将那台沉重的机器移除后，地面出现的巨大的空洞把我们引向了机械的更深处。这一行为的潜在损失到目前为止完全不能预估。
descriptions.en: Our workers managed to disassemble the machinery and used it with success to bolster the strength of the old supports and the ceiling - but what was the cost really? Removing the bulky machine resulted in a gaping hole in the ground leading deeper inside the machinery. Potential losses to this action are, for now, completely unknown.

descriptions.zh: 我们的工人能够正确评估局势，并设法在不破坏古老机械的前提下修复并加强支撑。
descriptions.en: Our workers were able to properly assess the situation and managed to repair and strengthen the supports without destroying the ancient machinery.

descriptions.zh: 收集了许多子个体的感官印象后，我们找到了更好的方案：我们以少量低级子个体为代价巩固大厅确保了安全。
descriptions.en: Gathering the sense impressions of various drones, a better solution was found: the hall has been strengthened to a safe degree at the cost of a few menial drones.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]上的探索终于让我们获得了一些洞见。我们最初的预计是正确的：该地下设施事实上是一座巨大的工厂。对外星语言的进一步的分析显示，它被称为“国王锻造厂”。然而，这座锻造厂其实并没有被启用，它的建造者显然缺乏完成这项工程的技术。

只要我们能深入到锻造厂的核心，我们应该就能完成他们未竟的工作。尽管这条通道被厚重的大门阻挡，我们的工程师坚信他们一定能解决这个问题。由于这扇大门并没有任何显而易见的闭锁或开启机制，显然我们可能需要对其施加一些强力手段才能继续推进。
descriptions.en:
Our exploration on [Root.GetName] finally yielded some insights. Our first assessment turned out to be correct. The vault is in fact a giant foundry. Further analysis of the alien language reveals that it was referred to as a King-Forge. However, the Forge was never operational - its builders apparently lacked the technology to see the project through to completion.

It should be possible for us to finish their work as long as we can get into the heart of the foundry. Although the way is blocked by heavy doors, our engineers insist they can be overcome. However, as the doors don't have any obvious locking or opening mechanisms, a certain application of force will be required before we can proceed.

tooltips.zh: 我们会试着用动力工具和重型机械撬开大门。如果运气好的话，我们应该不会碰上别的问题就能打开它。
tooltips.en: We will try to pry open the doors with power tools and heavy machinery. With some luck, we will be inside with no further problems.

tooltips.zh: 有时候暴力就是最好的解决办法。安置炸药尽快炸开它。
tooltips.en: Sometimes the violent approach is the best approach. Set explosives and be done with it.

tooltips.zh: 心急吃不了热豆腐。毕竟这里已经发现了那么多陷阱，有时候还是别匆忙用直接手段解决。
tooltips.en: Let's not be hasty. We encountered various traps before. Sometimes it's better not to rush with obvious solutions.

tooltips.zh: 我们擅长用不寻常的手段解决各种各样的问题，我们一定能找到其他进入的办法。
tooltips.en: We are skilled in overcoming problems with unusual solutions, so we might be able to find other way inside.

tooltips.zh: 我们的子个体可以轻松地切割大门的材料。虽然需要花费一些时间，但是我们有的是时间。
tooltips.en: Our drones will cut through the doors with ease. It will take some time, but we have all the time in the cosmos.

descriptions.zh: 在强行突破大门后，覆盖墙面的机械开始泄露有害气体。不幸的是这一切发生得太突然，造成了大量的伤亡。整座设施的工作人员需要紧急撤离，需要等到气体散去之后才能重新安全地进入设施。
descriptions.en: After forcing the doors, the machinery covering the walls started to leak hazardous gas. Unfortunately, this happened too quickly, and the result was further casualties. The entire facility needed to be evacuated, and will have to be left for some time before we can safely reenter.

descriptions.zh: 炸开大门是很容易，但我们没有料到的是爆炸后有气体开始涌入通道。这种气体高度易燃，并且摧毁了一部分原有的机器。幸运的是所有人都已经撤离了爆炸波及的区域，没有人员伤亡。
descriptions.en: Opening the door with explosives was easy, but what we didn't anticipate was the gas that poured into the hallway after the explosion. It turned out that the gas was highly flammable and destroyed some of the ever-present machinery. Fortunately, there was no one in the blast zone, so there were no casualties.

descriptions.zh: 无论是运气好还是圣灵眷顾，这一座之前阻碍我们去路的大门对我们今早的仪式产生了反应。它发出微微的共振，并且我们可以试着操纵它。在一处小标记隐藏着的摄像机镜头前做出正确的一套手势可以解开门锁让我们畅通无阻地进入。
descriptions.en: Whether by luck or divine intervention, the same door that blocked the way forward responded to our morning rituals: a faint harmonic resonance was detected, a resonance we were eventually able to manipulate. The correct set of gestures made in front of a small marking that concealed the lens of a camera ensured that we gained unobstructed entry.

descriptions.zh: 在进一步的研究后，我们很快发现了门的后面隐藏着一个安保相机或扫描仪。骇入相机是一个更困难的任务，但我们能够解码它的程序和基础功能，然后就能简单地获取通过大门的方法了。
descriptions.en: After additional research, we quickly recognized something in the door that served as a security camera or scanner. Hacking into it was a more difficult task, but we were able to decipher its programming and basic functions - thus gaining access to the door without further complication.

descriptions.zh: 看来钻穿大门的过程中我们的子个体激活了某种防御机制，过道的内部释放出了某种化学气体武器。幸运的是我们的集体意识能够采取恰当的应对措施，很快这些气体就散去了。这些子个体已经回去继续工作了。
descriptions.en: It appears in drilling through the door, our drones activated some defensive mechanism that unleashed weaponized gas inside the corridor. Fortunately, the Collective was able to take proper precautions, and soon enough the gas had dissipated. The drones have already returned to work.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]上的锻造厂的核心是一台遍布管道、传送带的扭曲网络，显然是某种工作站。通过快速调查我们发现了其缺失能源、维护和若干关键系统。此外还有充足的证据显示，我们探索这座地下掩体对这座锻造厂的内部工作过程造成了影响。我们可以试着修复它，虽然可能要花费一些时间。作为替代方案，我们也可以选择设置一个回收厂来拆解整个机械系统。
descriptions.en: The heart of the foundry on [Root.GetName] is a twisted network of pipes, conveyor belts, and what appear to be workstations. A quick survey revealed that power, maintenance, and key systems are missing. There is also reason to believe that our exploration of the vault has had some effect on the internal workings of the foundry. We can try to repair it, though it will be time consuming. Alternatively, we can always set up a scrapyard and dismantle the entire machine.

tooltips.zh: 我们会把机器接入行星电网并且修复它。
tooltips.en: We will plug the machinery into the planetary power grid and fix it.

tooltips.zh: 我们不仅要修复机器，还要研究它的工作原理。
tooltips.en: Fixing the machinery is not enough - we need to learn how it works.

tooltips.zh: 这座锻造厂可以为帝国做出贡献，并为我们提供关于原住民的潜在知识。
tooltips.en: This foundry will serve the empire and provide us with potential knowledge about its original inhabitants.

tooltips.zh: 这座锻造厂将会为蜂巢做出贡献，并为我们提供关于原住民的潜在知识。
tooltips.en: This foundry will serve the hive and provide us with potential knowledge about its original inhabitants.

tooltips.zh: 我们不仅要修复机器，还要研究它的工作原理。
tooltips.en: Fixing the machinery is not enough - we need to learn how it works.
