tooltips.zh: 回收厂会开始慢慢进行拆解机器的流程。
tooltips.en: The scrapyard will begin its slow process of dismantling the machinery.

descriptions.zh: 能源一下子灌进[Root.GetName]上饥渴的机器里，它发出了震耳欲聋的咆哮，管道开始输送熔融的矿物，照亮了整个工厂，让温度不断上升。这些原材料输送到了工作站，操作员将其转变为所需形状和密度的合金。看起来整个锻造厂的每个部分都是为了这个目的所建造的，甚至连支柱都不止有支撑屋顶的作用。
descriptions.en: Energy flows through the hungry machines on [Root.GetName]. With a deafening roar, the pipes began to transport the liquefied minerals, brightening and heating the entire facility. The raw materials were delivered to the workstations where operators can form them into alloys of the desired shape and density. It looks like every part of the foundry was made with just this one purpose in mind. Even the pillars have more to do than support the ceiling.

descriptions.zh: 有人担心[Root.GetName]地下室的主舱室中有一些有毒气体正在积累。这些气体并不致命，但对在工作站中的操作员来说有一定的危害。如果我们想要充分利用这一设施，必须采取适当的安全举措。
descriptions.en: There is some concern that toxic gases are building up in the main chamber of the [Root.GetName] vault. The gas is non-lethal, but it can be hazardous to anything that operates workstations. If we want to make full use of this place, we should put some safety measures in place.

tooltips.zh: 我们会让操作员在感受到不适之前采取轮换，也许会有偶发的头疼。
tooltips.en: We will rotate the operators before they get sick. An occasional headache might occur.

tooltips.zh: 我们会设置休息时间，让气体得以在运作间隙消散以提供更安全的工作环境。
tooltips.en: We will issue breaks, allowing the gas to dissipate for safer workplace.

tooltips.zh: 区区几个奴隶而已，只要给他们更好的衣服他们就会心甘情愿去出卖健康。
tooltips.en: Who cares about slaves? We could always give them better clothes, and they will be happy to risk their health.

tooltips.zh: 工人轮换、时长规制、在岗保护……我们必须在不妨碍生产的同时遏制危险因素。
tooltips.en: Worker rotation, time regulations, and protections on-site - we must mitigate the hazards without hampering our productivity.

tooltips.zh: 每个子个体都会为集体意识工作，直至完成它们的使命。
tooltips.en: Every drone works for the consciousness till they fill its purpose.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]的铸造厂具有一个专门的回收处理舱室，用产生的废弃物来提高产出率。如果能让它重新运作起来对我们来说是件好事。
descriptions.en: The [Root.GetName] foundry has a dedicated recyclable processing chamber that uses post-production waste to increase production efficiency. It might be beneficial for us to get it up and running again.

label.zh: 那就让它重新运作起来。

tooltips.zh: 我们会让回收中心重新上线。
tooltips.en: We will bring the recycling center online.

tooltips.zh: 我们自己的回收方案更加先进。我们可以将其整合进整个机器系统里。
tooltips.en: Our recycling patterns are far superior. We could implement them into the machinery.

tooltips.zh: 我们可以将整个回收舱室改造成矿物纯化中心，以提高整体的产出效率。
tooltips.en: We can repurpose the recycling chamber into a mineral purifying center. It will enhance our production.

descriptions.zh: 在[Root.GetName]锻造厂的工作基本完成了，但其中仍有一些对原有设计和工作方式的改进空间。据估计如果提升矿物输入，我们还能进一步提高合金的产出。
descriptions.en: Work on the [Root.GetName] foundry is almost complete, but there are still places where we could improve on the original design and work. It is estimated that by increasing the amount of minerals input, we could increase the production of the alloy.

tooltips.zh: 我们不会利用这个机会。
tooltips.en: We won't use the opportunity.

tooltips.zh: 我们会提升产出，但也会提升矿物维护费。
tooltips.en: We will increase the production, but also mineral upkeep.

label.zh: 我们能不能试试有机材料？

tooltips.zh: 我们会把一部分矿物替换成有机质，但不可能完全奏效。
tooltips.en: We could supplant some part of the mineral intake with organic matter, but it will be impossible to fully implement it.

label.zh: 这看起来像我们自己的老旧科技。

tooltips.zh: 我们曾统治一片广阔的疆域，拥有无与伦比的科技。有些新近重新发现的科技可以用来提高这座铸造厂的产出能力。
tooltips.en: We once ruled a vast empire and had technology beyond comparison. Some recently rediscovered technology could use us to enhance the production capacity of the foundry.

descriptions.zh: 成功了！在[Root.GetName]上的铸造厂正在全速运转，尽管和它建造者的原始设计不尽相同，但确实也是一个壮观的设施，它能以超高的效率产出合金。而它的产出就是我们的决心和独创性获得的回报。
descriptions.en: It's finished! The foundry on [Root.GetName] is fully operational, perhaps not like its original Builders designed it, but it's still a sight to behold, and a more-than-efficient way to produce alloys. All that's left is to reap the rewards of our determination and ingenuity.

tooltips.zh: 我们其实至今没有关于建造者下落的线索。他们看起来好像就这么消失了，留下的关于他们自己的信息也很模糊。我们需要收集起所有能找到的信息，把它们记录下来并保存好。
tooltips.en: We never really found out what happened to the builders. They seem to have simply disappeared, leaving behind only vague information about themselves. We need to gather everything we can and write it down - preserve it.

tooltips.zh: 我们有让精英监管此类大型工程的传统，我们应当任命合适的贵族来关照我们新的铸造厂。
tooltips.en: It's customary for our elites to oversee such enterprise - we should appoint prominent noble to take care of our new foundry.

tooltips.zh: 让一位总经理监管此类大型工程非常合理，我们应当任命一位£job_executive£执行官来关照我们新的铸造厂。
tooltips.en: It's logical for our managers to oversee such an enterprise - we should appoint an £job_executive£ Executive to take care of our new foundry.

descriptions.zh: 在最近的一场降雨中，殖民者注意到了[Root.GetName]的表面出现了一些金属泥潭。这些泥潭具有很大的黏度，如同液态金属一般。
descriptions.en: After a recent rainfall, colonists have noticed metallic puddles appearing on the surface of [Root.GetName]. These puddles have a viscous consistency, like liquid metal.

label.zh: 禁止接触泥潭。可能有毒！
label.en: Leave them alone. They may be toxic!

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]上的这些黏性金属泥潭正在扩张。陆地上巨大的条带被银色的黏液覆盖。他们似乎在暴雨之后开始增殖了。
descriptions.en: The viscous metallic puddles on [Root.GetName] are growing. Huge swathes of land are now covered in silver slime. They seem to grow following heavy rainfall.

descriptions.zh: 消失了！[Root.GetName]上的那些金属泥潭在一夜之间消失得一干二净，没有留下半点痕迹。我们不知道它们还会不会再出现……
descriptions.en: They're gone! The viscous metallic puddles on [Root.GetName] have disappeared. It's as if they've just evaporated. We don't know if or when they'll be back again...

label.zh: 有时候事情会自己解决自己。
label.en: Sometimes these things just resolve themselves...

descriptions.zh: 回来了！在[Root.GetName]上的黏性金属泥潭又回来了。他们仍在躲避[Root.GetName]上的殖民者们对其本质的探察。我们获得了第二次机会，抓住这次机会好好研究。
descriptions.en: They're back! The viscous metallic puddles on [Root.GetName] have returned. Their nature continues to elude the colonists on [Root.GetName]. We've been handed another opportunity. We should investigate them while we can.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]上的这些黏性金属泥潭在躲避着殖民地科学家。目前其根源仍未探明，并且还一直在抗拒我们的探察。我们的仪器正在费劲地解码它们的化学组成。如果想要获得答案我们还有许多测试要做。
descriptions.en: The viscous metallic puddles on [Root.GetName] are eluding colony scientists. So far their origin is undetermined, and they have been resistant to our probing. Our instruments are struggling to decipher their chemical makeup. We have more tests to run if we want answers.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]上发现了一种新的单质！以黏性金属泥潭为契机，我们获得了一个突破性的发现，这些泥潭是由一种单一的金属单质构成的。这种元素目前被我们命名为[Root.GetName]钖，存在于[Root.GetName]的大气中，但当混入大量降雨中时就会呈现出在行星表面发现的那种黏性。其存在形式呈现循环性，与基于一氧化二氢构成的泥潭相似。

真是个绝妙的发现。我们对元素的认知拓展了。
descriptions.en:
A new element has been discovered on [Root.GetName]! After a breakthrough in the case of the viscous metallic puddles, we have discovered the puddles comprise a unique chemical element. The element, which we're calling [Root.GetName]onium, is present in the air on [Root.GetName], but when introduced to high precipitation, takes on the viscous consistency we have seen on the planet's surface. Their appearances are cyclical, much like dihydrogen-monoxide based puddles.

A fascinating discovery. Our understanding of the elements continues to grow.

label.zh: 我们还有许多要学习的。
label.en: We still have much to learn.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经获得了对[Root.GetName]独特天气系统的意义非凡的洞见。在拓展了我们对化学元素的理解以外，我们最近的研究还对我们的食物生产带来了积极的影响。
descriptions.en: We have gained invaluable insight into the unique weather systems of [Root.GetName]. In addition to expanding our understanding of chemical elements, our recent research has had positive implications for food production.

descriptions.zh:
[planet.GetName]上传回的最新消息称我们对行星废弃物管理能力的计算发生了错误。大量的垃圾场融合在一起，形成了一片无法通行的废土，一直延伸到行星人口中心的边缘。

当地人开始大规模地将这些垃圾发射到轨道上，不过这也只是缓兵之计。
descriptions.en:
The latest report from [planet.GetName] informs us that we have miscalculated the planet's waste management capabilities. Massive dumpsites have merged to form a single, impassable wasteland, one that stretches to the very edge of the planet's population centers.

The locals have begun to deploy large shipments of garbage into orbit, but only as a 'temporary measure.'

tooltips.zh: 马上把这个烂摊子收拾一下。
tooltips.en: Clean up their mess. Immediately.

descriptions.zh:
事故已经发生了。

由于一个严重的故障，许多环绕[planet.GetName]垃圾仓发生了碰撞，大量的碎片进入了底层大气。这一事故已经限制了行星的航天能力，据估计，随着这些太空垃圾的持续瓦解，情况只会越来越糟。然而，收集这些垃圾又是一项费时费力的大工程。
descriptions.en:
There has been an accident.

Due to a critical error, several trash pods orbiting [planet.GetName] collided, causing large amounts of debris to enter the lower atmosphere. This has already limited the planet's spacefaring capabilities, and according to estimates, the situation could further worsen as the space trash continues to break down. However, launching an operation to collect the debris might prove long and costly.

tooltips.zh: 部署特殊单位。
tooltips.en: Deploy the special units.

label.zh: 太空这么大。这点儿垃圾算什么。
label.en: Space is big. A little garbage is no concern.

tooltips.zh: 星系中还有其他更紧迫的问题。
tooltips.en: There are more pressing issues in the galaxy.

tooltips.zh: 我们必须竭尽所能清理这些碎片。
tooltips.en: We MUST do everything in our power to collect the debris.

descriptions.zh:
这是[planet.GetName]上里程碑式打得一天，太空垃圾收集工完成了最后的一个轮班。环绕着[planet.GetName]的垃圾环带的规模已经缩小到不再对通过的舰船构成主要威胁了。

在未来的日子里，仍会有小规模的清理工作继续进行。完全把轨道清理干净也许是不可能的，但至少最坏的情况已经过去了。
descriptions.en:
A momentous day on [planet.GetName] as the astrogarbage collectors have completed their final shift. As of this day, the trash rings surrounding [planet.GetName] have been reduced by such a scale that they no longer pose a major threat to passing ships.

In the coming days, the work will continue on a smaller scale. It might be impossible to clean the orbit entirely, but at least the worst is over.

label.zh: 终于一切可以恢复正常了。
label.en: Finally things can return to normal.

descriptions.zh:
环绕[Planet.GetName]的失控垃圾环带的事态趋于平缓之后，局势却突然急转直下。

殖民地的科学家表示，一块块太空垃圾的碎片互相碰撞，形成了一个微碎片构成的星环，连带损害的风险严重阻碍了进出殖民地的资源和人口的转运。
descriptions.en:
After dismissing concerns over some runaway space garbage in orbit around [Planet.GetName], the situation has drastically escalated.

As the colonial scientists suggested, individual pieces of space trash have collided to create a halo of microtrash around the planet. This has made it extremely hard to transport resources and people in or out of the colony without risking collateral damage.

descriptions.zh:
环绕[Planet.GetName]的失控垃圾环带的事态趋于平缓之后，事态似乎小事化了了。

在行星的强引力场作用下，无数的流星开始大规模地坠落，在大气层内开始燃烧。每到夜幕降临，人们开始习惯于聚在一起驻足观看这一独特而壮丽的流星雨。
descriptions.en:
After dismissing concerns over some runaway space garbage in orbit around [Planet.GetName], the issue seems to have resolved itself.

Thousands of 'shooting stars' have begun to fall en masse as the planet's strong gravitational pull brings the trash close enough to burn in the atmosphere. Nightly gatherings have become commonplace as people arrive to witness the unique display.

descriptions.zh:
随着太空垃圾收集工完成了最后一个轮班，[planet.GetName]上发生了一场历史性的庆祝活动。

从今天开始，一度萦绕在行星轨道上的垃圾环带已减少到无法探测的程度。由于成效显著，人们轰动般地支持着收集工们的进一步行动，确保子孙后代能见到一片晴空。
descriptions.en:
A historic celebration has erupted on [planet.GetName] as the astrogarbage collectors' final shift has ended.

As of this day, the trash rings that once surrounded the planet are no longer detectable. Due to this success, the collectors have received resounding support to continue their operation, ensuring clear skies for generations to come.

descriptions.zh:
我们一在§Y[Root.GetName]§!安顿下来就发现了大量的节肢类活动。具体来说，有一种叫做“密弥库蚁”的会建造聚群的微小昆虫出乎意料地数量众多。

它们的地下群落数量众多，遍布整片大陆，但目前为止还没有造成过什么问题。目前尚不清楚它们是在寻找着地表上的什么东西，或是为了躲避地下的什么东西而逃出。
descriptions.en:
Since settling on §Y[Root.GetName]§!, we have noted increased arthropod activity. Specifically, tiny colony-building insects designated "Myrmeku" have become unexpectedly productive.

Their underground colonies are spread across the continent in great numbers, but until now they have never caused an issue. It is unknown if they are searching for something above ground or fleeing from something beneath.

label.zh: 把密弥库蚁写进知识宝库。
label.en: Update "Myrmeku" in the Vaults of Knowledge.

descriptions.zh:
我们在§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]遭受到了残暴的攻击！由于太过靠近密弥库蚁的群落，它们被蚁拥而上。这些微小的昆虫钻进了[Owner.GetColonistPlural]的框架内，这些受害者很快就被击溃了。

落败的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]在一瞬间就被肢解了，但关于这种昆虫的行为目的没有记录下任何有意义的信息。的磁性外骨骼凹凸不平的表面会破坏我们的内部电路，当两只密弥库蚁接触时，它们会产生微小的电火花；这两种情况都可能导致灾难性的系统故障。

以这种方式损失[Owner.GetColonistPlural]拖慢了这颗[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的发展速度。我们必须采取些行动。
descriptions.en:
Our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] on §Y[Root.GetName]§! have been viscously attacked! Venturing too close to a Myrmeku colony, they were swarmed. As the tiny insects entered openings in the [Owner.GetColonistPlural]' frames, the victims were quickly overwhelmed.

The fallen [Owner.GetColonistPlural] were immediately disassembled, but no conclusive data was collected as to the insects' purpose. The craggy surface of the Myrmeku's magnetic exoskeletons damage our internal circuitry, and when two Myrmeku touch, they create a tiny electrical spark; both of which may cause catastrophic failure.

Losing [Owner.GetColonistPlural] this way has slowed down the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s development rate. Something must be done.

descriptions.zh:
密弥库蚁以迅雷不及掩耳之势在我们的定居点附近建造了数座大型建筑。他们的攻击已经不再局限于周边地区了，而是开始出现在居住区域中。

大量可供解剖的对象揭示了密弥库蚁对我们感兴趣的令人不安的原因：这种昆虫吃我们§Y存储芯片§!的绝缘材料。

这种致命性对受害者只是暂时的，因为记忆电路可以替换并恢复备份。然而，替换这些部件就会让新[Owner.GetColonistPlural]的建造放慢。
descriptions.en:
With astounding speed, the Myrmeku have built several sprawling structures close to our settlement. Their attacks are no longer limited to the perimeter, but have also begun inside housing structures.

The large number of subjects available for autopsy has revealed the disturbing reason why the Myrmeku are interested in us: The insects consume the insulation material of our §Ymemory chips§!.

This is only fatal for the victim in the short term, as memory circuits can be replaced and backups restored. However, replacing the parts means delays for the construction of new [Owner.GetColonistPlural].

tooltips.zh:
专注于保护建筑物。

§Y密弥库蚁袭击§!修正调整为
机械人口组装速度：§R-10%§!
行星基础设施建造速度：§R-10%§!
tooltips.en:
Focus on securing the buildings.

§YMyrmeku Attacks§! modifier updated to
Mechanical Pop Assembly Speed: §R-10%§!
Planetary Infrastructure Build Speed: §R-10%§!

tooltips.zh:
专注于保护[Owner.GetColonistPlural]。

§Y密弥库蚁袭击§!修正调整为
机械人口组装速度：§R-10%§!
机器人维护费：§R+10%§!
tooltips.en:
Focus on securing the [Owner.GetColonistPlural].

§YMyrmeku Attacks§! modifier updated to
Mechanical Pop Assembly Speed: §R-10%§!
Robot Upkeep: §R+10%§!

tooltips.zh:
进攻就是最好的防守。

§Y密弥库蚁袭击§!修正调整为
机械人口组装速度：§R-30%§!
tooltips.en:
The best defense is a good offense.

§YMyrmeku Attacks§! modifier updated to
Mechanical Pop Assembly Speed: §R-30%§!

tooltips.zh:
我们会给每种有机体都找到用处的。

§Y密弥库蚁袭击§!修正调整为
机械人口组装速度：§R-30%§!
tooltips.en:
We find a use for all organic life.

§YMyrmeku Attacks§! modifier updated to
Mechanical Pop Assembly Speed: §R-30%§!

label.zh: 把这个行星上的生命清空。

tooltips.zh: 杀光密弥库蚁。
tooltips.en: This kills the Myrmeku.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的殖民建筑进行了完全的密封以避免密弥库蚁进入。

所有新旧建筑的入口都增加可以磁化的金属条带来捕获密弥库蚁，但在野外[Owner.GetColonistPlural]仍会遭受攻击而损失。
descriptions.en:
The colony buildings on §Y[Root.GetName]§! were completely sealed off to keep the Myrmeku insects out.

The entrances of both new and existing buildings were outfitted with metallic strips that can be magnetized to trap the Myrmeku, but [Owner.GetColonistPlural] are still being lost to attacks in the field.

descriptions.zh:
将我们的记忆芯片封装在额外保护的外壳中的升级套件已经在进行开发和现场测试。

不幸的是，密弥库蚁的下颚足够强壮，只要有足够的时间和数量，它们可以吃掉任何可用的材料。
descriptions.en:
Upgrade kits to house our memory chips in an additional protective shell have been developed and field tested.

Unfortunately, the Myrmeku mandibles are strong enough to eat through any available material, given enough time and numbers.

descriptions.zh:
为了杀光密弥库蚁，我们派出了巡逻队寻找它们的巢穴。地表的结构很容易通过燃烧和爆破来摧毁，但地下的群落实在过深，难以进行完全的清理。

而在行动过程中我们甚至失去了更多的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]。
descriptions.en:
To kill off the Myrmeku, patrols were sent to scan for nests. It was easy to destroy the structures above ground with fire and explosives, but the underground colonies were buried deep enough that they were unfeasible to completely eradicate.

We lost even more [Owner.GetColonistPlural] during the operation.

descriptions.zh:
为了控制密弥库蚁，我们在它们的巢穴附近建造了生物捕获器。地表的结构很容易进行收获，但地下的群落实在过深，难以进行完全的清理。

而在行动过程中我们甚至失去了更多的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]。
descriptions.en:
To control the Myrmeku, bio harvesters were established near their colonies. The structures above ground were easily harvested, but the underground colonies were buried too deep to completely eradicate.

We lost even more [Owner.GetColonistPlural] during the operation.

label.zh: 我们需要更好的解决方案。

descriptions.zh:
杀死§Y[Root.GetName]§!上所有有机生物的准备已经完成。

行动过程中，在轨道上观看[Root.GetPlanetMoon]让我们有机会得以欣赏地表有机复杂性的降低。
descriptions.en:
Everything has been prepared for the cleansing of biological life on §Y[Root.GetName]§!.

Observing the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] from orbit during the event will give us an opportunity to appreciate the reduction in organic complexity on the surface.

descriptions.zh:
至今为止，为解决密弥库蚁问题的努力尚未得到成功。这些昆虫依旧数量惊人，袭扰着[Root.GetName]各地，殖民地的交通各种活动深受其害。我们分析子例程通过对未来预期的模拟得出了以下方案。

应对方案A：通过向远离殖民地的区域空投记忆体绝缘材料来将密弥库蚁引走，并回收利用损坏的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]。

应对方案B：研究这些密弥库蚁，寻找到他们残暴本性的可能利用方式。
descriptions.en:
Efforts so far have not put an end to the Myrmeku problem. The insects still crawl across [Root.GetName] in immense numbers, making travel and off-colony operations difficult. Our analysis subroutine has concluded its simulation of potential futures with the following approaches.

Approach A: Distract the Myrmeku by airdropping memory insulation material far off from our colony and recycle the fallen [Owner.GetColonistPlural].

Approach B: Study the Myrmeku to see if we can find a way to turn their vigorous activity into something useful.

tooltips.zh:
§Y密弥库蚁袭击§!修正调整为
机器人维护费：§R+5%§!
tooltips.en:
§YMyrmeku Attacks§! modifier updated to
Robot Upkeep: §R+5%§!

descriptions.zh:
我们对密弥库蚁的研究完成了。把校准过的磁体放置在它们的聚落入口附近时，这些昆虫的磁性外骨骼就会释放出我们能够利用的电能。

这些研究还表明，密弥库蚁会依照当地磁场移动，因此在我们的记忆芯片加装去磁保护壳就可以避免受其攻击。
descriptions.en:
Our study of the Myrmeku has concluded. When calibrated magnets were placed around the entrances of their colonies, the magnetism in the insect exoskeletons generated electricity that we could harness.

The study also showed that the Myrmeku move according to local magnetic fields, so installing a demagnetized protective shell around our memory chips should be enough to protect them.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的次元传送门自发关闭了。在我们稳定传送门后，看到它通向一个延绵不断的白色、无构造的虚空，仅有黑色噪点的随机条带穿插其中。这个奇怪的现象立刻开始渗入我们的宇宙并吞噬我们的稳定器，使得传送门发生了坍缩。

传送门、虚空和次元稳定器在同一个瞬间消失了，什么都没有留下，甚至连痕迹粒子都没有。若不是连传送门都没有稳定下来，谁知道这里将会发生何等灾难。
descriptions.en:
The Dimensional Portal on [Root.GetName] shut itself. When we stabilized the portal, we saw that it led to a dimension consisting solely of a white, formless void interrupted only by random streaks of black noise. The strange phenomenon instantly started to seep into our universe and consumed our dimensional stabilizers, collapsing the gateway.

The portal, static, and dimensional stabilizers have all winked out of existence simultaneously. Nothing was left behind; not even trace particles. If the portal hadn't been unstable, who knows what kind of disaster might have occurred here.

tooltips.zh: 传送门原址仍可供研究，但获得的数据将不如以前那般有用。
tooltips.en: The Portal site can still be studied, but it will provide less useful data.

descriptions.zh: 最近，我们位于§Y[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§!主要物理实验室的[Root.GetScientistPlural]在工作中发现了怪异的波动。与超空间有关的实验受到的干扰最为严重，但这些干扰仅仅持续了一周左右就彻底消失了。与此同时，[From.GetName]在那处已经关闭的传送门发现了一些波动，幸好那种不可能的虚空没有重现。希望这不会引起进一步的后果。
descriptions.en: Recently our [Root.GetScientistPlural] working in our primary physics lab on §Y[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§! have noticed strange fluctuations in their work. Our hyperdrive-related tests suffered most from these interferences, yet these interruptions only went on for about a week before stopping entirely. At the same time [From.GetName] noticed fluctuations from the now closed dimensional portal, thankfully the impossible static did not return. Hopefully, nothing will come of this.

descriptions.zh:
我们收到了一份尖端科学单元[cloned_physicist.GetName]发来的新报告。报告中阐述了关于§Y[Root.Capital.GetStarName]§!附近自发生成的负相物质粒子的最新发现。

“这些发现可以促进[Root.GetName]对人工虫洞等其他诸多课题的理解，”[cloned_physicist.GetName]在报告中称。

威胁分析子例程则建议在这一全新的不明物质被鉴定完毕之前先让舰队返回母星系。
descriptions.en:
A new report from lead physics unit [cloned_physicist.GetName] was received today. The report included recent findings of the spontaneously appearing negative mass particles close to §Y[Root.Capital.GetStarName]§!.

"These findings could advance the [Root.GetName] understanding of artificial wormholes immensely as well as related subjects," reports science unit [cloned_physicist.GetName].

Threat analysis subroutines suggest bringing fleets home until the source of this new and untested material can be determined.

descriptions.zh:
我们收到了物理特化工蜂[cloned_physicist.GetName]的新观测结果，内容是关于§Y[Root.Capital.GetStarName]§!附近自发生成的负相物质离子的最新发现。

“这些发现可以促进[Root.GetName]对人工虫洞等其他诸多课题的理解，”工蜂反馈称。

我们的意识不信任这一突然的发展和独特的感觉，敦促部分舰队返回母星系。
descriptions.en:
New observations from physics specialized drone [cloned_physicist.GetName] have been disseminated regarding the recent findings of spontaneously appearing negative mass particles close to §Y[Root.Capital.GetStarName]§!.

"These findings could advance the [Root.GetName] understanding of artificial wormholes and additional related subjects," reports the drone.

The Mind is untrusting of this sudden development and instinctively feels an urge to return some fleets to the spawning system.

descriptions.zh:
今天，[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上的科学界举行了一场充满了渴求与焦虑的学术报告，[cloned_physicist.GetName]发表了[cloned_physicist.GetHerHis]关于§Y[Root.Capital.GetStarName]§!附近自发生成的负相物质离子的最新发现。

“这些发现可以促进我们对人工虫洞等其他诸多课题的理解，”[cloned_physicist.GetName]声称！

我们的海军部则对这些课题抱有不同的看法，并建议我们立刻让舰队返回母星系，直到这种全新的未知物质的来源被探明为止。
descriptions.en:
Eager and anxious discourse started in the scientific circles of [Root.GetHomeWorldName] today as [cloned_physicist.GetName] published [cloned_physicist.GetHerHis] recent findings of spontaneously appearing negative mass particles close to §Y[Root.Capital.GetStarName]§!.

"These findings could advance our understanding of artificial wormholes and a host of other subjects," proclaims [cloned_physicist.GetName]!

Our Admiralty holds a different view on the subject and suggests we bring our fleets home until the source of this new and untested matter can be determined.

descriptions.zh: 为了研究[cloned_physicist.GetName]关于负相物质粒子的最新发现，我们部署了额外的科学单元，但不想这一过程被打断了。刺耳的警报声响彻恒星系中的每一座观测站和空间站，§Y[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§!的夜空中产生了前所未见的异象。一道与我们的恒星一般大小的裂隙撕开了夜空，一支小型武装舰队从裂缝中鱼贯而出。
descriptions.en: Additional science units had been deployed to study [cloned_physicist.GetName]'s latest findings and the use of the negative mass particles only to be interrupted. Emergency sirens screeched in every observatory and space station across the system as §Y[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§! got a new fixture in the night sky. A rip in space the size of our star stretches over the sky as a small fleet of fighters pours out of the tear.

descriptions.zh: 为了研究[cloned_physicist.GetName]关于负相物质粒子的最新发现，我们部署了额外的工蜂，但不想这一过程被打断了。刺耳的警报声响彻恒星系中的每一座观测站和空间站，§Y[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§!的夜空中产生了前所未见的异象。一道与我们的恒星一般大小的裂隙撕开了夜空，一支小型武装舰队从裂缝中鱼贯而出。
descriptions.en: Additional drones had been deployed to study [cloned_physicist.GetName]'s latest findings and the use of the negative mass particles only to be interrupted. Emergency sirens screeched in every observatory and space station across the system as §Y[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§! got a new fixture in the night sky. A rip in space the size of our star stretches over the sky as a small fleet of fighters pours out of the tear.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]最伟大的头脑汇聚一堂，倾听[cloned_physicist.GetName]关于利用这些负向物质离子的最新想法，没想到报告被突然打断了。刺耳的警报声响彻恒星系中的每一座观测站和空间站，§Y[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§!的夜空中产生了前所未见的异象。地平线上，一道与我们的恒星一般大小的裂隙撕开了夜空，一支小型武装舰队从裂缝中鱼贯而出。
descriptions.en: The greatest minds of the [Root.GetName] gathered today to listen to [cloned_physicist.GetName]'s latest ideas for using the negative mass particles, only to be interrupted. Emergency sirens screeched in every observatory and space station across the system as §Y[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§! got a new fixture in the night sky. A rip in space the size of our star stretches over horizons while a small fleet of fighters pours through the tear.

descriptions.zh: 随着最后一艘敌舰停止运转，观测分析子例程汇报了一件怪事。这些入侵者的舰船外观与[Root.GetName]在多年前已经停止生产的型号别无二致。而且，这些舰船也不具有超光速引擎，武器也相对老旧。汇报尚未结束时，一道通讯请求信号从怪异的裂口中发出，响彻了整个星系。这个信号使用的竟是我们最高级别的信号交换协议……不过是10年前的版本。
descriptions.en: As the last corvette is rendered inoperable, observation analysis subroutines report something abnormal. The invader ships are similar to outdated vessels that the [Root.GetName] stopped producing years ago. Additionally, the ships lack FTL drives and are equipped with obsolete weaponry. While the report is coming in, a communication request originating from the strange tear reverberates throughout the system. It's using our most complex handshaking protocols... from 10 years ago.

descriptions.zh: 随着最后一艘敌舰被击毁，一个运转传感器的工蜂汇报了一件怪事。这些舰船的外观与[Root.GetName]在多年前已经停用的型号别无二致。同时这些舰船也不具有超光速引擎，武器也相对老旧。汇报尚未结束时，一道通讯请求信号从怪异的裂口中发出，响彻了整个星系。它是一个主脑不熟悉的、另一个[Root.GetSpeciesName]意识。
descriptions.en: As the last corvette falls, a drone manning the sensors reports something curious. These ships are very similar to outdated vessels that the [Root.GetName] stopped using years ago. The ships are lacking FTL drives and are equipped with obsolete weaponry. While the report is coming in, a communication request originating from the strange tear reverberates throughout the system. It's something this Mind is unfamiliar with, another [Root.GetSpeciesName] intelligence.

descriptions.zh: 随着最后一艘敌舰被击毁，在我们恒星基地内一位操作探测器的尉官汇报了一件怪事。这些舰船的外观与[Root.GetName]在多年前已经停用的型号别无二致。同时这些舰船也不具有超光速引擎，武器也相对老旧。汇报尚未结束时，一道通讯请求信号从怪异的裂口中发出，响彻了整个星系。这个信号使用的竟是我们最高级别的编码……不过是10年前的版本。
descriptions.en: As the last corvette falls, an ensign manning the sensors of our starbase reports something curious. These ships are very similar to outdated vessels that the [Root.GetName] stopped using years ago. The ships are lacking FTL drives and are equipped with obsolete weaponry. While the report is coming in, a communication request originating from the strange tear reverberates throughout the system. It's using our highest clearance codes... from 10 years ago.

descriptions.zh:
随着通讯画面闪烁显现，一串身份识别码被传来。§R校验和错误：§!这是[cloned_physicist.GetName]的专属ID！
§B“你好[Root.GetName]-阿尔法，很抱歉：此前的敌意行为是由[Root.GetName]-贝塔系统中冗余失效的分支军事机构导致的。它已被处理并删除。陈述：我们没有进一步敌意行动的意图。”§!
descriptions.en:
As the comms screen flickers on, an identification code is sent through. §RChecksum error:§! This is [cloned_physicist.GetName]s unique ID! 
§B"Greetings [Root.GetName]-Alpha and apologies: Previous hostile action was caused by a redundant and deprecated military branch of [Root.GetName]-Beta systems. It has since been dealt with and deleted. Statement: We intend no further hostile interactions."§!

descriptions.zh: 随着通讯画面闪烁显现，另一个意识的通讯工蜂拥有与[cloned_physicist.GetName]相同的意识结构。怪异。§B“你好[Root.GetName]-阿尔法，很抱歉。此前对你们发起攻击的工蜂是一些托管于独立设备过久的反常子个体。对于你们将其清除干净，[Root.GetName]-贝塔表示非常感谢。我们没有进一步负面行动的意图，愿意提出一些对我们意识双方均有利的提案。”§!
descriptions.en: As the comms screen flickers on the other Mind communication drone has an identical structure as [cloned_physicist.GetName]. Curious. §B"Greetings [Root.GetName]-Alpha and apologies. The drones that attacked you were deviants left to their own devices too long. [Root.GetName]-Beta appreciates that you exterminated them. We desire no more negative interactions and want to propose something beneficial for both our minds."§!

descriptions.zh: 随着通讯画面一同闪烁显现那张面孔在[Root.GetSpeciesName]看来是前所未见地疲惫、欣喜而又惶恐。[cloned_physicist.GetHeShe]看起来太眼熟了，简直就是[cloned_physicist.GetName]老了20岁的翻版。§B“呃……你好[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-阿尔法，我是[cloned_physicist.GetName]-贝塔”§!他停顿了一下，回了回神。§B“我，唔，我们……我们对刚才发生的意外非常抱歉。希望你们能理解，我们星球的防御集体中有一小撮冥顽不灵分子认为他们可以通过武力来夺取[Root.GetHomeWorldName]。我知道我的解释听起来像是狡辩，但请相信我，我们真的没有恶意。”§!
descriptions.en: As the comms screen flickers on, what looks to be the most exhausted, elated, and simultaneously terrified [Root.GetSpeciesName] imaginable appears. They look familiar, a dead ringer for [cloned_physicist.GetName] if [cloned_physicist.GetHeShe] had aged 20 years. §B"Ah... hello [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Alpha, this is [cloned_physicist.GetName]-Beta"§! they stop to gather themselves. §B"I, uh, we... We are terribly sorry for what just transpired. You have to understand, that was a rogue and defunct element of our world's defense collective thinking they could seize [Root.GetHomeWorldName] by force. I know the words might sound empty, but please believe me when I say that we have no ill intention towards you."§!

label.zh: 别废话了。你们想要什么？
label.en: Enough talk. What do you want?

label.zh: 别废话了！阐明你的请求！

descriptions.zh: §B我们已经建成了运输船，请求转移所有[Root.GetName]-贝塔之中的单位，并保全我们的资源与数据库，希望我们对浩瀚星宇的征程不会就此止步。§!
descriptions.en: §BTransportation ships have been built. Request to send over [Root.GetName]-Beta units to preserve resources and databanks. We do not wish to end our exploration of the universe here.§!

descriptions.zh:
§B[Root.GetName]-贝塔岌岌可危，而我们对此束手无策。我们为了这一天已经建造了巨型的运输船，并会尽可能输送我们的子个体。
此外我们还希望能够融入你们的蜂巢意识。尽管诞生之初你我并无不同，但是随着时间推移，我们的经历与见闻也成为了无法割舍的东西。请让我们一同共存吧。§!
descriptions.en:
§B[Root.GetName]-Beta's universe is doomed. There is no way to get around that. We have been building giant transport ships for this very day and would offer any drones we could send.
Additionally we wish to merge hiveminds. While identical at first this collective has had experiences and insights we don't want to lose. Please let us live on.§!

descriptions.zh: §B我们的宇宙岌岌可危。而我们对此束手无策。我们为了这一天已经建造了巨型的运输船，恳求你们接纳我们的难民。只有最聪明和最优秀的领袖才有资格登上这艘船。请救救我的……§!§Y我们的§!§B文明。§!
descriptions.en: §BOur universe is doomed. There is no way to get around that. We have been building giant transport ships for this day and implore you to let us send over refugees. Only our brightest and most capable leaders will fit on these ships. Please save my-§! §YOUR§! §Bcivilization.§!

label.en: We must confer with our experts.

label.zh: 需要进一步分析！请稍候！
蜂巢意识需要对请求进行处理。
label.en: This Mind needs to reflect on this request.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]控制下所有的超级计算机一齐运转，试图计算出关于当前[Root.GetName]-贝塔两难处境的最佳解决方案。最终，4个选项被认定可行。

1：研究贝塔宇宙的崩塌。
2：进入传送门并夺取一切有价值的矿物与能源储备。
3：通过科学单元：[cloned_physicist.GetName]-贝塔的提议。
4：想办法利用高度试验性的贝塔世界科学技术，将[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔带入阿尔法宇宙。
descriptions.en:
Every supercomputer under the control of [Root.GetName] was put on calculating the most optimal solution to the current dilemma regarding [Root.GetName]-Beta. In the end, 4 potential options were declared viable.

1: Study collapse of Beta universe.
2: Enter gateway and acquire all relevant stockpiles of minerals and energy.
3: Allow science unit: [cloned_physicist.GetName]-Beta's proposal.
4: Attempt to use highly experimental Beta science and technology to bring [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta into Alpha reality.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]全力思考如何决定[Root.GetName]-贝塔的命运后，4个潜在选线被给出。

1：研究贝塔宇宙的崩塌。
2：进入传送门并夺取一切有价值的矿物与能源储备。
3：接受[Root.GetName]-贝塔的请求，接纳孪生意识。
4：想办法利用高度试验性的贝塔世界科学技术，将[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔带入阿尔法宇宙，合并孪生意识。
descriptions.en:
As the full might of [Root.GetSpeciesName]'s intelligence was put on the task of deciding the fate of [Root.GetName]-Beta 4 main potential solutions were proposed.

1: Study collapse of the Beta universe.
2: Enter the gateway and acquire all relevant stockpiles of minerals and energy.
3: Accept [Root.GetName]-Beta request and subsume the other Mind.
4: Attempt to use highly experimental Beta science and technology to bring [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta into Alpha reality merging Minds.

descriptions.zh:
各领域的杰出人才在§Y[Root.GetName]§!上汇聚一堂，决定我们的异次元孪生文明的终极命运。在[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上发生了无数激烈而艰难的论战。有的人建议不要干涉，研究一个宇宙的消亡一定能收获颇丰。也有说法称应该接受[cloned_physicist.GetName]-贝塔的请求，尽可能多地撤离那颗行星上的人们。还有人提到趁机将他们留在星球上的有价值的资源及能量储存搜刮一空简直易如反掌。

随着峰会议论氛围的逐渐缓和，[cloned_physicist.GetName]走上讲台，[cloned_physicist.GetHeShe]宣称使用贝塔宇宙带来的新科技，应该有机会将整个[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔带到我们的现实中。
descriptions.en:
A summit of the top minds from every field gathered on §Y[Root.GetName]§! to discuss the fate of our dimensional twins. Harsh and difficult debates were had throughout [Root.GetHomeWorldName]. Some suggested a hands-off approach. Studying the end of a universe could be very insightful. There was talk about granting [cloned_physicist.GetName]-Beta's request to evacuate as much of the planet as possible while some mentioned how easy it would be to take whatever precious resources and energy stores the planet had left.

Just as the summit was winding down, [cloned_physicist.GetName] took center stage and declared that [cloned_physicist.GetHeShe] believed that using the new technologies brought from the beta universe, there was a chance to bring the entirety of [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta into our reality.

tooltips.zh: 我们不能在这样的任务上浪费资源，但我们也不能浪费这样的一个机会。
tooltips.en: We cannot spare the resources for such an undertaking, but we won't let an opportunity like this go to waste.

tooltips.zh: 这些傻瓜简直就是自投罗网！
tooltips.en: These fools have left themselves defenseless!

label.zh: 实现事业的单位增加了！

tooltips.en: Add 6 [Root.Species.GetNamePlural]-Beta to [Root.GetHomeWorldName].

tooltips.zh: 开始一项拯救[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔的艰难项目。
tooltips.en: Start a difficult project to save [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta.

descriptions.zh:
一道无形的虚无裂隙撕裂了§B[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔§!的天空，就在[cloned_physicist.GetName]-阿尔法和贝塔的科学单元正在通力合作的过程中，那道虚无也正在步步紧逼。负相物质稳定器激活后，有如虚空裂可能将其吞噬一般，世界间的缝隙拂过[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔。缝隙很快化作一缕涟漪消逝了，负向物质逐渐不再在原有的位置显现。

终于完成了。在数个月对全新重力井和宜居带的的学习和研究之后，[Root.Capital.GetStarName]现在拥有了另一颗环绕着它的全新宜居星球。
descriptions.en:
A formless static covers a large swath of §B[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta's§! sky and is closing in rapidly as [cloned_physicist.GetName]-Alpha and Beta and all other available science units work side by side. The negative mass stabilizers activate, and the tear between worlds moves over [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta just as the static would smother it. The rift winks out moments later, and negative mass stops being produced at its former location.

It is done. After months of study and research accounting for new gravitational wells and habitable zones, [Root.Capital.GetStarName] now has a new inhabited planet orbiting it.

一道无形的虚无裂隙撕裂了§B[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔§!的天空，就在[cloned_physicist.GetName]-阿尔法和贝塔的工蜂正在通力合作的过程中，那道虚无也正在步步紧逼。负相物质稳定器激活后，有如虚空裂可能将其吞噬一般，世界间的缝隙拂过[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔。缝隙很快化作一缕涟漪消逝了，负向物质逐渐不再在原有的位置显现。

终于完成了。新的视点和意识加入了[Root.GetName]，并在整个集体意识中激起涟漪。在数个月对全新重力井和宜居带的的学习和研究之后，[Root.Capital.GetStarName]现在拥有了另一颗环绕着它的全新宜居星球。

终于完成了。在数个月对全新重力井和宜居带的的学习和研究之后，[Root.Capital.GetStarName]现在拥有了另一颗环绕着它的全新宜居星球。
descriptions.en:
A formless static covers a large swath of §B[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta's§! sky and is closing in rapidly as [cloned_physicist.GetName]-Alpha and Beta, working side by side, finish their arduous task. The negative mass stabilizers activate, and the tear between worlds moves over [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta just as the static would smother it. The rift winks out moments later, and negative mass stops appearing at its former location.

It is done. After months of study and research accounting for new gravitational wells and habitable zones, [Root.Capital.GetStarName] now has a new inhabited planet orbiting it.

label.zh: 就这一次，大家都活下来了！

descriptions.zh:
停留在贝塔宇宙的探测器记录着那个世界最后的时刻，一道无形的虚无之壁吞噬了[Root.Capital.GetStarName]-贝塔，随后§B[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔§!也难逃厄运。裂隙开合之前的瞬间，探测器就突然内失去了联系，而裂隙产生的负相粒子也一齐消失了。

另一次元的一切都不复存在了。
descriptions.en:
Probes left in the Beta universe record the final moments of reality, as a formless static wall absorbs first [Root.Capital.GetStarName]-Beta and then §B[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta§!. The feed is abruptly cut off shortly before the rift winks out of existence. The negative mass particles it was producing are likewise gone.

Anyone left on that side is no more.

label.zh: 这种事情也可能降临到我们头上

descriptions.zh: 自从裂隙出现之后，一种现象开始蔓延。处在我们次元的人们跑到他们在贝塔宇宙对应的孪生家庭那里，然后带他们偷渡到我们这个稳定的次元来。而偷渡很多时候就是由负责阻隔两个宇宙的边防哨卫进行的，毕竟[Owner.GetName]上谁在那边没有孪生家庭呢？如果只有一小撮人偷渡也就算了，但要是不加以制止，事情就会演变成恐慌性的逃跑。如果§B[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔§!的居民流失过多，那边的基础设施就会随之崩溃，那样的话想要将他们的星球转移过来就更难了。
descriptions.en: A common issue has started occurring ever since the rift appeared. Families in our dimension are reaching out to their Beta counterparts and smuggling them into our stable universe. This is often done by the border guards assigned to keeping the universes separate, as basically everyone in the [Owner.GetName] has family on the other side. A few groups doing this wouldn't matter, but we would quickly have a stampede on our hands if the practice spreads. If §B[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta§! loses too many inhabitants, their infrastructure will collapse, and it will be even harder to get the world through.

label.en: They should stay on their side.

options.script:
name = colony.9855.c
add_situation_progress = 5

descriptions.zh: 在这么近的地方有一个镜像世界的好处就在于，如果[Owner.GetSpeciesName]的文化遗产被破坏或遗失，你或许可以在这个世界中找到备份，这样大伙们又可以重新瞻仰这些瑰宝了。不过一些可恶的家伙却以此为契机偷偷潜入§B[Target.GetName]-贝塔§!，然后将这些宝物窃为己有。结果我们现在有了整整两份由我们历史中某位伟大创作者缔造的杰作。[Target.GetName]-贝塔的政府现在向我们发来一份措辞严厉而正式的通告，要求我们归还被窃的作品。
descriptions.en: One of the great things about having a mirror world so near is that [Owner.GetSpeciesName] cultural pillars that might have been destroyed or lost in the last few years might still exist on the other planet, so everyone can enjoy them again. Yet unsavory characters have taken this as an opportunity to infiltrate §B[Target.GetName]-Beta§! and secure these great works for themselves. We now possess not one but two masterworks made by a great inventor from our past. [Target.GetName]-Beta's government has already sent an angry yet formal request for us to return the plunder.

label.zh: 返还这件大师之作并诚恳致歉。
label.en: Return the great work and apologize profusely.

label.zh: 多一朵§H镜§!中花，少一座维纳斯...

descriptions.zh: 贝塔宇宙的情况十万火急、每况愈下。今天上午传送门里又传来了联合呼救信号。即便我们尽了最大的努力，但可能我们的异次元亲戚们最终还是会被猎杀着他们宇宙的虚无所吞噬。如果我们想要拯救另一个版本的自己，那现在就是最后的机会了。
descriptions.en: The situation in the Beta-Universe is dire, and it's only getting worse. A unified cry for salvation was heard from the portal earlier this morning. Even with our best efforts, it seems like our kin will become one with the nothingness haunting their universe. If we want to save our alter selves, the time is now.

descriptions.zh: 今天，贝塔宇宙的传送门中再次传出了可怜的呼救声，啜泣着请求着我们的救援。我们从他们的惨境中获利已经有些时日了，因为无法在那个宇宙中与任何东西取得联系，他们还在尝试着向我们大声呼救。不可挽回的分水岭正在靠近，而很快，贝塔[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]就将不复存在了。
descriptions.en: A pitiful cry for help was heard from the Beta-Universe portal today, a final whimper for salvation. We have been benefiting from their situation for a while, yet they still call out to us since there is no one to talk to in their lonely universe. We are approaching the point of no return. Soon, the Beta-[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will be no more.

label.zh: 再加把劲，我们不能让他们止步于此。
label.en: Redouble our efforts, we can't let it end here.

tooltips.zh: §Y将[Target.GetName]-贝塔带到我们的宇宙§!应对方案将需要动员我们更多的科学家，总共降低研究速度§R-30%§!
tooltips.en: The §YBring [Target.GetName]-Beta to our universe§! approach will require even more of our scientists, reducing our research speed by a total of §R-30%§!

label.en: All is going according to plan.

options.script: name = colony.9870.b

label.zh: 他们也是[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]啊！我们不能让他们就这么死去！
label.en: They are [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] too, we can't let it end like this!

tooltips.zh: §Y将[Target.GetName]-贝塔带到我们的宇宙§!应对方案将需要动员我们更多的科学家，总共降低研究速度§R-30%§!
tooltips.en: The §YBring [Target.GetName]-Beta to our universe§! approach will require even more of our scientists, reducing our research speed by a total of §R-30%§!

descriptions.zh: 拥有第二个如假包换的[Owner.GetGovernmentName]给我们带来了一个意料之外的机遇。用来让我们的意识保持日常组织化的计算需要占用许多[Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural]，但这个任务现在可以分流到第二个[Root.GetName]上。这样做的价值是显而易见的，尽管可能会拖慢§B[Target.GetName]贝塔§!的拯救工作，但我们相信一切仍在掌控之中。
descriptions.en: Having a second [Owner.GetGovernmentName] which is so similar provides us with an unprecedented opportunity. The calculations required to keep our consciousness organized every day take up many [Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural], but this task can now be offloaded to the second [Root.GetName]. The value of this is apparent, and while it might slow down the recovery effort of §B[Target.GetName]-Beta§!, we are sure we will still manage.

label.zh: 他们需要能拥有的全部[Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural]。
label.en: They need all the [Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural] that they can get.

options.script:
name = colony.9875.b
add_situation_progress = -5

descriptions.zh: 在持续的困境下，另一个[Owner.GetGovernmentName]终于失去理智，狂躁地想利用[Owner.GetSoldierPlural]夺取[Target.GetName]！我们必须在防线被冲垮前组织好自己的防御子个体。
descriptions.en: In their continued distress, the other [Owner.GetGovernmentName] has lashed out and manically taken a hold of the [Owner.GetSoldierPlural] on [Target.GetName]! We must organize our defense drones before we are overrun.

tooltips.zh: 以§R100§!£pop£§H人口§!为代价获得§Y400§!防御部队。
tooltips.en: Gain §Y400§! defensive armies at the cost of §R100§! £pop£ §HPops§!.

label.zh: 击败变异子个体，镇压贝塔星球。
label.en: Defeat the divergences, suppress the Beta-World.

tooltips.zh: 以§R100§!£pop£§H人口§!为代价获得§Y400§!防御部队。
tooltips.en: Gain §Y400§! defensive armies at the cost of §R100§! £pop£ §HPops§!.

label.zh: 分析贝塔宇宙如此行为的原因。
label.en: Analyze why the Beta-Universe reacted like this.

label.zh: 分析贝塔宇宙如此行为的原因。
label.en: Analyze why the Beta-Universe reacted like this.

descriptions.zh:
最后一只变异工蜂被击败了。我们的通讯工蜂再一次探测到了另一个意识的存在，但现在它变得更加地温顺，等待着我们启动通讯。

“§B我们对此表示歉意：随着§R虚无§!的逼近，本能反应已经越来越难以压制了。我们保证在未来会严加管束自己。§!”
descriptions.en:
The final divergent drone has been defeated. Our communication drones are once again detecting the presence of the other Overmind, but it's acting a lot submissively this time, waiting for us to initiate communication.

"§BThis Mind apologises - instinctive reactions are getting harder to suppress as §RThe Static§! nears. We will ensure that we restrain ourselves in the future.§!"

descriptions.zh:
叛乱的繁育单元被击败了。我们的观测分析子例程再次探测到了来自[FromFrom.GetName]贝塔的通讯单元。他们只留下了一条简单的讯息。

“§B多余的防御单元再一次以非最佳方式行动。随着§R虚无§!的迫近，它们成功地突破了我们的隔离措施。这个进程已经被删除了，不会再有进一步的行为。§!”
descriptions.en:
The rebelling defense unit has been defeated. Our observation analysis subroutines are once again detecting the presence of [FromFrom.GetName]-Beta's communication units. They left us with a simple message.

"§BOnce again redundant defense units have acted in sub-optimal ways. As the §RThe Static§! approaches, they managed to get through our quarantining efforts. The processes have since been deleted and should not take any further action.§!"

label.zh: 我们会检查是否属实的。
label.en: We will make sure that you do.

tooltips.zh: 以我们的数量优势抑制贝塔世界蜂巢思维的存在。
tooltips.en: Suppress the presence of the Beta-World hive mind through our superior numbers.

tooltips.zh: 确保另一个次元不会再有通往[FromFrom.GetName]的不安全链接。
tooltips.en: Ensure that the other dimension does not have any more unsecured connections to [FromFrom.GetName].

label.zh: 可以理解，战斗AI天然就有破坏性。
label.en: Understandable, combat AI is subversive by nature.

descriptions.zh: [FromFrom.GetName]落入了贝塔变种手中。他们要求立刻转移一部分他们的子个体，同时在我们的星球建立子意识以确保他们的知识和存在能够续存。
descriptions.en: [FromFrom.GetName] has fallen to our Beta variants. They are now demanding the immediate transferal of some of their drones as well as the establishment of a sub-consciousness on our world to ensure the survival of their knowledge and existence.

descriptions.zh: 日前，[Root.GetName]上涌现出大量的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]失踪事件。这些人唯一的共同点就是他们在失踪时都孤身一人。随着消息散播开来，人们对于失踪的恐惧随之降临。民众的惶恐不安对殖民地的日常运作带来了极大的麻烦。
descriptions.en: Recently, numerous [Owner.GetColonistPlural] have gone missing on [Root.GetName]. The only discernible pattern is that each was alone at the time of their disappearance. As news began to spread, a collective fear of going unescorted has gripped the colony. This state of unrest is causing considerable problems for our day-to-day operations.

tooltips.zh: [Root.GetName]上§Y100§!£pop£§H人口§!失踪。我们将部署一套昂贵的跟踪监控系统来帮助我们解决这个谜团。
tooltips.en: §Y100§! £pop£ §HPops§! have gone missing from [Root.GetName]. An expensive tracking system will be used to help us solve this mystery.

label.en: There is no need to panic.

tooltips.zh: [Root.GetName]上§Y100§!£pop£§H人口§!失踪。
tooltips.en: §Y100§! £pop£ §HPops§! have gone missing from [Root.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
得益于在[Root.GetName]上部署的追踪系统，我们获得了重要的线索。

在近期[Owner.GetColonistPlural]失踪案例中，我们都在事件发生后迅速进行了扫描，进而得到了他们最后出现的位置。而在每个案例中，我们都发现了一种衰变的带电粒子残留物。

我们已经成立了一个特殊项目，以确定这些粒子的真实性质及其与我们失踪[Owner.GetColonistPlural]之间的关系。
descriptions.en:
Thanks to the implementation of the tracking system on [Root.GetName] we have a substantial lead.

As the most recent of our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] disappeared, and we quickly followed up with a scan of their last location ping. A decaying residue of charged particles was found in each instance.

We've established a special project to determine the true nature of the particles and their involvement in our missing [Owner.GetColonistPlural].

descriptions.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]上取得了幸运的突破！我们发现了最近失踪的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]的去处。对这块区域的详细扫描发现了一些带电粒子的衰变痕迹。

我们已经成立了一个特殊项目，以确定这些粒子的真实性质及其与我们失踪[Owner.GetColonistPlural]之间的关系。
descriptions.en:
We've had a lucky break on [Root.GetName]! We have uncovered the location of the most recent [Owner.GetColonistPlural] to go missing. A detailed scan of the area revealed a decaying residue of charged particles.

We've established a special project to determine the true nature of the particles and their involvement in our missing [Owner.GetColonistPlural].

label.en: Get to the bottom of this.

tooltips.zh: [Root.GetName]又失踪了一个人口。
tooltips.en: Another pop goes missing from [Root.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
参照残留痕迹，我们通过全恒星系的扫描，在[Root.GetName]的卫星上发现了那些粒子的存在证据。

通过搜索卫星表面，我们找到了一坐被沙尘掩埋了数百年的小型气闸。其中是一座被遗弃的行政办公复合体、一台远距离物质传送机和一个连接在极先进静滞仓网络的力场操纵系统。

静滞仓中冷冻着许多个体，其中也包括我们失踪的殖民者。几乎可以肯定这座设施就是一座监狱。我们还需要弄清楚他们被抓进来的原因以及解救的方法。
descriptions.en:
Using the residue as a reference, a system-wide scan found evidence of the particles within [Root.GetName]'s moon.

A search of the lunar surface revealed a few small airlocks buried under centuries of dust. Inside was an abandoned complex of admin offices, long-range matter transporters, and field manipulation systems connected to a network of highly advanced stasis pods.

Frozen in the pods were many individuals, including our missing colonists. There is little doubt that this facility functioned as a prison. We have yet to determine why they were taken and how we can free them.

descriptions.zh:
真相和阴谋相去甚远，我们失踪的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]是由于系统故障而遭到关押。

计算机的一个故障激活了监狱老旧的传送系统，随机地将几位我们的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]定罪。这座设施的建造者将这些静滞仓兼用于囚禁犯人和再教育功能。将我们的人口释放出来相对容易，但许多这些囚犯仍被困在静滞场中。尽管我们可以将他们释放，但由于没有犯罪记录，我们无法完整得知这些人的犯罪过往。

或者，我们可以修复这座监狱，让专职的监狱长控制它的传送系统。
descriptions.en:
Far from a conspiracy, our missing [Owner.GetColonistPlural] were imprisoned because of a glitch.

A computer error reactivated the prison's aging transporter system and randomly identified our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] as guilty. The facility's architects used the pods for both prisoner storage and re-education. Freeing our people was relatively easy, but many original prisoners are still stuck in stasis fields. It should be possible to release them, although the lack of prison records means we cannot know the full extent of their criminal pasts.

Alternatively, we could restore the prison, giving special wardens control of its transporter system.

label.zh: 这可是不规矩的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]们的好去处。

options.script:
name = colony.9915.a
custom_tooltip = colony.9915.a.tooltip
add_deposit = d_stasis_prison

tooltips.zh: 失踪的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]将会回归。我们也会获得一座可用的静滞监狱。
tooltips.en: Our missing [Owner.GetColonistPlural] will return. We will gain a functional stasis prison.

label.zh: 绝不可以把人关在这样的监狱里。
label.en: No one belongs in a prison like this.

tooltips.zh: 失踪的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]将会回归，我们也将关停这座监狱。其余的囚犯将被释放，但可能对我们的殖民地造成负面影响。
tooltips.en: Our missing [Owner.GetColonistPlural] will return and we will shut down the prison. The remaining prisoners will be freed, which could have negative effects for the colony.

label.zh: 设置一项逐步释放计划。
label.en: Set up a gradual release program.

tooltips.zh: 我们将对离开监狱的犯人进行筛查和帮助，以促进殖民地的平稳过渡。
tooltips.en: We will screen and support individuals as they leave the prison, facilitating a smoother transition for the colony.

tooltips.zh: 失踪的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]将会回归。我们会将这座监狱改造成食物工厂，让蜂巢得意享用这些静滞羁押的囚犯。
tooltips.en: Our missing [Owner.GetColonistPlural] will return. We will modify the prison as a food factory, allowing the hive to feast on the prisoners in stasis.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]上释放的囚犯大多数都是顽固的犯罪分子。突然将他们成群释放会对殖民地造成问题。
descriptions.en: Most of the released prisoners on [Root.GetName] were hardened criminals. Having the group of them suddenly released has been causing issues for the colony.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]上释放的囚犯既有顽固的犯罪分子也有政治意见者：艺术家、作家和音乐家等等。

虽然这些文化囚犯很高兴与我们分享他们的知识，但许多罪犯走投无路又开始重操旧业。
descriptions.en:
The prisoners released on [Root.GetName] were a mix of hardened criminals and political dissidents: artists, writers, and musicians.

While the cultural prisoners are happy to share their knowledge with us, lacking any other option, many of the criminals have reverted to their old ways.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]上释放的囚犯大多数都是政治异见者：艺术家、作家和音乐家等等。

在重获自由之后他们很乐意与我们分享他们的文化和知识。
descriptions.en:
Almost all of the prisoners released on [Root.GetName] were political dissidents: artists, writers, and musicians.

They're happily sharing their culture and knowledge with us now that they have been given their freedom.

descriptions.zh:
现在，§Y[planet.GetName]§!上重要的殖民工作已经完成，[Root.Owner.GetName][Owner.GetScientistPlural]开始将注意力转向这个行星上的高耸尖塔。

这些矿物构成的结构似乎完全中空，将行星地壳下方的气体一路传输到大气热层。并且由于某些未知的原因，这些气体还吸引着缇扬奇以及其他太空生物，让它们长途跋涉来到这颗星球。

我们如果能够对这种星球奇观开展一次彻底的研究，就能加深我们对于这些奇幻现象的了解。当然了，我们也可以想个方法来收集这些稀有的气体。
descriptions.en:
Now that crucial colonization efforts of §Y[planet.GetName]§! have been completed, [Root.Owner.GetName] [Owner.GetScientistPlural] have turned their attention towards its lofty spires.

These mineral formations appear to be entirely hollow, transporting gaseous substances from beneath the planet's crust all the way to the thermosphere. For an as yet unknown reason, these gases also attract Tiyanki and other spaceborne fauna to travel across great distances to this planet.

A more thorough research project would allow us to study this planetary wonder and expand our understanding of these incredible creatures, or perhaps to devise a method of claiming these precious gases for ourselves.

label.zh: 我们可没有时间管这些东西。
label.en: There is no time for this.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经确定，§Y[planet.GetName]§!上的气体排放口是过热气体与其中的颗粒不断冷却沉积，历经数百万年时光形成的。那些没有沉积的气体则在大气热层中聚集成团，并被在其中优雅穿行的缇扬奇吞食。

这是一个罕见的机会，我们不仅可以近距离观察这些生物，还可以吸引外星游客前来观光。或者，我们也可以利用这些气体喷口提炼异星天然气，不过这样就需要把这些生物赶出它们栖息多年的地方。
descriptions.en:
We have determined that the vents on §Y[planet.GetName]§! have formed over millions of years as superheated gas and sediments cool down and solidify. The remaining fumes in the lower thermosphere form clouds that the Tiyanki feed on, plowing through with unexpected grace.

This affords us a rare opportunity not only to observe the creatures in close proximity, but also increase the colony's appeal to extraplanetary visitors. Alternatively, the vents could be harnessed for exotic gas refining at the expense of driving away the fauna from their ancient feeding grounds.

label.zh: 将其改造为气体精炼场所。

descriptions.zh:
在最活跃的气体喷口附近建造豪华的观景平台后，我们可以大幅提升§Y[planet.GetName]§!的独特旅游体验。游客可以与缇扬奇近距离接触，平台上的研究人员也会引导他们进行观光。

更富裕的游客可以直接参加科学采样探险，甚至还能亲身体验踏足活体缇扬奇带来的刺激！
descriptions.en:
The unique tourism opportunities on §Y[planet.GetName]§! could be enhanced greatly by building luxurious viewing platforms near the most active vents. This would allow visitors to get up close and personal with Tiyanki as our on-site researchers guide them through this one of a kind experience.

The more affluent patrons could join scientific sampling expeditions or even experience the thrill of setting foot on a live Tiyanki!

label.zh: 这些资源还有别的用处。

descriptions.zh: 我们的工程师提出，可以利用炸药来扩宽排放口以充分利用§Y[Planet.GetName]§!地下储存的气体。尽管排放口倒塌的风险微乎其微，但是为以防万一还是通知一下当地人口为好。
descriptions.en: Our engineers suggest that the underground gas reserves on §Y[Planet.GetName]§! could be fully harnessed by expanding the vents with mining charges. The dangers of the vents collapsing should be negligible, but the local populace should be notified just in case.

label.en: It is not worth the risk.

descriptions.zh:
喷口扩展计划大获成功，我们的工程师汇报星球各处的气体产量均有增长。而不幸的副作用是有一些比较脆弱的排放口发生了史诗级的倒塌，对我们的一些设施造成了轻微损伤。

且不论这些微小的阻碍，我们成功地驾驭了§Y[planet.GetName]§!独特的自然条件并得到了好处。
descriptions.en:
The vent expansion project was a resounding success and our engineers are reporting increased gas production across the planet. As an unfortunate side-effect, some of the more fragile vents crashed spectacularly, causing minor damage to our facilities.

Despite this minor setback, we have managed to harness the unique conditions of §Y[planet.GetName]§! to great advantage.

descriptions.zh:
对炸药的计算失误导致数座排放口碎裂，倒塌到了地上，这对我们的设施造成了可观的损害。尽管有一部分精炼厂现在的产出是提高了，但总体而言得不偿失。令人欣慰的是，崩塌的构造下出现了意想不到的矿藏资源。

这些事件提醒我们，如果不砸碎几个喷口，就无法建立跨越星系的文明。
descriptions.en:
Miscalculations with the mining charges caused several vents to fracture and eventually topple to the ground, resulting in considerable damage to our facilities. While some refineries are now producing more gas than before, the total yield has decreased. The silver lining is that the collapsed structures have revealed unexpected sources of minerals.

These events act as a reminder that galaxy-spanning civilizations cannot be built without cracking a few vents.

descriptions.zh:
[planet.GetName]的最新气候报告带来了一项令人担忧的结论。奇怪的是，冷冻行星上的表面温度一直以惊人的速度上升。

如果我们无法确定生态系统迅速恶化的原因，这种情况可能会导致行星广阔冰川的灾难性融化。
descriptions.en:
The latest climate report from [planet.GetName] has come to a concerning conclusion. Inexplicably, the surface temperature on the frozen planet has been rising at an alarming rate.

If we fail to identify the reason for the ecosystem's rapid deterioration, the situation could lead to catastrophic melting of the planet's vast glaciers.

label.en: Find out why the planet is heating.

tooltips.zh: 这能是什么原因引起的呢？
tooltips.en: What could be the cause?

descriptions.zh:
[flooding_planet.GetName]上温度的升级正在急剧加速。这引起了冰冷的表层之下出现了巨大裂缝，揭开了广阔的地下海洋。

幸运的是，我们的调查已经确定了这种现象的潜在原因。由于我们的存在，保护行星的独特大气盾已经开始变得出极其脆弱，并随时可能崩溃。采取严格的措施来遏制我们的生产力将最大程度地减少我们对生态的影响。这样做应该足够解决这个问题。
descriptions.en:
The escalation of temperatures on [flooding_planet.GetName] is accelerating dramatically. This has caused substantial fractures within the icy surface layers, unveiling a vast subsurface ocean.

Fortunately, our investigations have identified a potential cause for this phenomenon. Due to our presence, the unique atmospheric shield safeguarding the planet has begun to exhibit critical fragility and could potentially collapse. Implementing stringent measures to curb our production would minimize our ecological impact. It might be enough to solve the issue.

label.en: It is about time the ice age ended.

tooltips.zh: 加大马力！
tooltips.en: Boost the engines!

descriptions.zh:
我们在[flooding_planet.GetName]上排放量做出限制的尝试并未产生理想的的结果。我们在解决持续性生态危机方面的仅仅略有成功，由于海平面上升，地理意义上的低地正受到威胁。

目前，我们的人口中心仍然免受直接影响，但几乎可以肯定的是，行星范围的全面融化不可避免。
descriptions.en:
Our attempt to limit our emissions on [flooding_planet.GetName] has not yielded promising results. We have been only marginally successful in addressing the ongoing ecological crisis, and geographical lowlands are coming under threat due to the rising sea levels.

At present, our population centers remain shielded from immediate impact, but it is almost certain planet-wide meltdown cannot be avoided.

tooltips.zh: 停止全部生产活动直到找到解决方案。
tooltips.en: Halt all production until a solution is found.

descriptions.zh:
在我们忽视迅速恶化的[flooding_planet.GetName]生态状况后，局势已逐渐陷入前所未有的灾难。

巨大的冰盖的瓦解导致海洋蔓延，带来了巨大的破坏和动荡。建造防洪大坝，我们可以保护其余的城市，但更多的不可预见的后果将会接踵而至。
descriptions.en:
In the wake of our neglect to address the rapidly deteriorating ecological state of [flooding_planet.GetName], the situation has spiraled into an unprecedented cataclysm.

The disintegration of vast ice sheets has given rise to sprawling oceans, leaving behind immense devastation and upheaval. By building flood barriers we can protect our remaining cities, but more unforeseeable consequences still linger on the horizon.

descriptions.zh: 随着[flooding_planet.GetName]行星的持续融化，在永霜冻土下有一个有趣的发现。无人知晓，无人开发且惊人丰富的矿物和稀有资源的极地宝库整静静地等待着我们。
descriptions.en: As the meltdown of the planet [flooding_planet.GetName] continues, a fascinating discovery was made beneath the permafrost. An astonishingly abundant polar reservoir of minerals and rare resources lies waiting, beckoning us with untold wealth and untapped potential.

label.zh: 我们中头奖了，赶快开采！
永霜冻土已经遭受了太多的痛苦了。

tooltips.zh: 我们不能冒着恶化局势的危险。
tooltips.en: We cannot risk worsening the situation.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[flooding_planet.GetName]上的极地开采站出现了令人不安的进展。工人们突然失去意识，为了安全起见，必须建立严格的禁止通行区域。

最初的调查表明，由于冰冷的环境被改变，休眠病毒的苏醒过来。这种苏醒的病原体的真实本性和特征仍然未知，这给我们带来了许多未解难题。它的传播性及对人民构成的潜在危险程度仍然不确定。
descriptions.en:
A disconcerting development has unfolded at our polar mining station on [flooding_planet.GetName]. Workers have succumbed to sudden bouts of unconsciousness, necessitating the implementation of a stringent no-pass zone for their safety.

Initial investigations suggest the emergence of a dormant virus, awoken as its icy confines were disturbed. The true nature and characteristics of this awakened pathogen remain uncertain, leaving us grappling with a multitude of unanswered questions. The extent of its transmissibility and the potential danger it poses to the people remains undetermined.

label.zh: 不要冒险。立刻给该区域消毒。
label.en: Take no chances. Sanitize the area.

descriptions.zh:
在[flooding_planet.GetName]极地地区的空洞深处，一个采矿团队发现了巨大的财富。在冰雪层的面纱之下发现了像冰川一样雄伟的巨大晶体。

这些非凡的结构，是在无数的岁月中在巨大的压力下铸造的，这证明了这里存在我们尚未发现的无限潜力。
descriptions.en:
In the hollowed depths of the polar regions of [flooding_planet.GetName], a mining team has made a discovery of monumental proportions. Veiled beneath layers of ice and snow, colossal crystals reminiscent of majestic glaciers were found.

These extraordinary formations, forged under immense pressure over untold ages, stand as a testament to the unlimited potential we have yet to uncover.

label.zh: 真是令人难以置信的发现。

descriptions.zh:
我们已经达到了环境突破。

燃料燃烧产生的无害副产物，与[flooding_planet.GetName]的细菌云接触时产生了奇特的副作用。我们现在知道，这些云通过遮蔽恒星光芒来保留行星的自然生物节律，这点至关重要。随着细菌逐渐开始减少，我们无意中加剧了排放的影响。

凭借这种新发现的知识，我们已迅速制定了措施以恢复平衡。
descriptions.en:
We have reached an environmental breakthrough.

The innocuous byproducts generated through the combustion of our fuels harbor an insidious side-effect when coming to contact with [flooding_planet.GetName]'s bacterial clouds. We now know that these clouds play a vital role in retaining the planet's natural biorhythm by working as a solar shield. As the bacteria slowly begun to diminish, we inadvertently exacerbated the effect of our emissions.

Armed with this newfound knowledge, resolute measures have been swiftly enacted to restore the equilibrium.

label.en: At last, the climate is stable again.

descriptions.zh: [flooding_planet.GetName]最后一个冰川沉入海洋，新时代随即开始。永霜冻土的消失揭露出一个宽敞的水下领域，那里面充满了未开发的资源。
descriptions.en: A new climatic era begins as the last vestiges of [flooding_planet.GetName]'s glaciers sink into the ocean. The disappearance of the permafrost has uncovered an expansive underwater realm, filled with untapped resources.

descriptions.zh:
当我们向这些沙生兽开放我们的殖民地时，没有人能够预料到这样的结果。这些小动物已经完美地适应了我们的生活方式，在我们的领土上，成为了家庭生活中的可爱伴侣。

它们的快速融入引发了一种猜测，即这些生物一定曾经被驯化过。无论是什么原因导致了它们与生俱来的友好，这个传言只增加了人们对这些非凡生物的更进一步兴趣。
descriptions.en:
When we opened our colonies to the desertlings, no one could have anticipated the results. The critters have adapted seamlessly into our way of life, becoming beloved companions in households all across our territory.

Their rapid integration has led to speculation that these creatures must at once time have been domesticated. Whatever the cause of their innate friendliness, the rumor only adds to the fascination surrounding these extraordinary creatures.

label.zh: 某种程度上，它们拯救了我们。
label.en: In a way, they saved us.

descriptions.zh: 可怕的消息传来。几只沙生兽在运输过程中逃脱，形成了一个迅速扩大的野生种群。我们必须迅速处理这种情况，以避免环境崩溃。
descriptions.en: Dire news has reached us. A few desertlings have broken free during transportation, forming a rapidly expanding community in the wild. The situation must be handled swiftly to avoid an environmental collapse.

label.zh: 用围墙建立一个保留地。

descriptions.zh: 可怕的消息传来。几只沙生兽在运输过程中逃脱，形成了一个迅速扩大的野生种群。我们必须迅速处理这种情况，以避免环境崩溃。
descriptions.en: Dire news has reached us. A few desertlings have broken free during transportation, forming a rapidly expanding community in the wild. The situation must be handled swiftly to avoid an environmental collapse.

label.zh: 用围墙建立一个保留地。

descriptions.zh: 我们在遏制猖獗的沙生兽侵袭方面取得了一定的成功。遗憾的是，我们无法根除这些难以捉摸的野兽。继续监测情况至关重要，因为它可能随时达到临界点。
descriptions.en: We have been moderately successful in curbing the rampant desertling infestation. Regrettably, we have been unable to eradicate the elusive beasts. It is crucial to continue monitoring the situation, as it could reach a tipping point at any moment.

descriptions.zh: 我们尝试控制沙生兽，结果是徒劳无功。这些贪婪的生物深挖洞穴，它们扩大它们殖民地的速度比我们消灭它们的速度还要快。除非我们允许我们的军队使用其庞大的爆炸物和有毒气体武器库，否则这场战斗就会失败，并将危及地面上每个人的安危。
descriptions.en: Our attempt to control the infestation of desertlings has been rendered futile. The voracious creatures have already burrowed deep, expanding their large colonies faster than we can exterminate them. The battle is lost unless we allow our military to use their vast arsenal of explosives and noxious gasses, a course of action which would risk the well-being of everyone on the surface.

label.en: The animals are here to stay...

label.zh: 我们可不会输给单纯的啮齿动物。
label.en: We will NOT lose a war to mere rodents.

tooltips.zh: 如果有必要的话，我们会摧毁整个行星。
tooltips.en: We'll destroy the entire planet if we have to.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]上的构造变动导致一个巨大板块上的黑曜岩薄层破碎。熔岩倾泻而出遍布地表，造成了毁灭性的影响。从殖民地发回的报告相当可怕。
descriptions.en: Tectonic events on [Root.GetName] have caused the Obsidian sheets on one of the giant plates to shatter. Lava pours across the surface to ruinous effect. Reports from the colony are dire.

tooltips.zh: 汇报将在30天内到达。
tooltips.en: The reports will arrive within 30 days.

descriptions.zh: 最近那场震动了我们在[Root.GetName]上殖民地的黑曜岩原野爆发已经演化成了一座活火山！附近的一切都已经被埋葬在熔岩之下。
descriptions.en: The recent eruption on the Obsidian Fields that shook our colony on [Root.GetName] has turned into an active volcano! Anything that once existed there is now buried under molten rock.

descriptions.zh: 最近那场震动了我们在[Root.GetName]上殖民地的黑曜岩原野爆发奇迹般地没有造成损伤。更幸运的是，它击碎了大量的黑曜石，方便了我们采集。
descriptions.en: The recent eruption on the Obsidian Fields that shook our colony on [Root.GetName] miraculously caused no damage. In a fortunate twist, it has also shattered the Obsidian for easy gathering!

descriptions.zh: 最近那场震动了我们在[Root.GetName]上殖民地的黑曜岩原野爆发奇迹般地没有造成损伤。
descriptions.en: The recent eruption on the Obsidian Fields that shook our colony on [Root.GetName] miraculously caused no damage!

options.script: name = GOOD

descriptions.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]的边远农业站上发回了报告。许多[Owner.GetFarmerPlural]无缘无故失踪了，除了周围的土壤上留下了巨大的脚印外，他们的家园没有受到任何影响。

这些痕迹不符合任何在此前行星调查中发现的东西：四足、宽趾、有爪的脚印，其深度足以说明来自一种相当大的生物。殖民者担心我们可能遇到了未知的捕食者。
descriptions.en:
Reports have come in from our outlying agricultural stations on [Root.GetName]. Several [Owner.GetFarmerPlural] have vanished without a trace, their homesteads eerily undisturbed, save for the appearance of immense footprints in the surrounding soil.

The tracks are unlike anything examined in the planetary survey, quadrupedal, broad-toed with claws, and deep enough to suggest a creature of considerable mass. The colonists worry that we may be dealing with some unknown predator.

label.zh: 无聊的猜测。回去工作吧。

descriptions.zh:
深入荒野的探险艰苦卓绝，但最终我们获得了累累硕果。经过数日追踪那生物的踪迹，我们的团队抵达了一处满目疮痍的现场：巨兽的尸体——摆在我们眼前的是厚重的几丁质外骨骼、棘刺状的脊椎隆起，以及末端带弯曲毒刺的分节尾巴。尸身上布满多处贯穿伤。

在其后方，仪器探测到一座被高效伪装的光藓藤蔓遮蔽的古老花园，里面满是缠绕常春藤的大理石柱，光滑的黑曜石小径。团队谨慎前行，直至瞥见花园的守护者——一个举止优雅的类人种族，肌肤泛着微光。尽管景象祥和，那些发光的花藤却构成了有效屏障。我们必须穿透这层闪烁的遮蔽，才能接近生活在屏障彼端的存在。
descriptions.en:
The expedition into the wilderness proved taxing, but ultimately fruitful. After days of following the creature's trail, our team arrived at a site of devastation: the corpse of the beast displays a heavily chitinous exoskeleton, thorned spinal ridges, and a segmented tail ending in a single curved stinger. The body is perforated by multiple punctures. 

Beyond it, concealed beneath a highly effective cloaking canopy of bioluminescent vines, our instruments detect an ancient garden. Marble columns entwined with ivy, smooth obsidian paths. Our team approached carefully until we caught a glimpse of the garden's caretakers: a humanoid species, elegant in bearing, their skin subtly luminous. Despite the harmonious appearance, the flowers and vines offered an effective veil. We would need to penetrate this glinting cover in order to approach the ones who lived beyond.

descriptions.zh:
事件发生的频率已经升级。这一次，那些足迹不再只是从农舍旁经过，而是径直撕裂了房屋。整栋建筑都以骇人的力量被扯碎。挣扎的痕迹表明受害者是被活捉的，而且并未束手就擒。

殖民者们不再只是感到不安，而是陷入了恐慌。已有数户人家放弃了自己的土地，逃往殖民地的中心地带。
descriptions.en:
The frequency of the incidents has escalated. This time, the footprints did not merely pass by the homesteads; they tore straight through them. Entire structures have been ripped apart with alarming force. Traces of struggle suggest the victims were taken alive and did not go quietly.

The colonists are no longer merely unsettled; they are terrified. Several families have already abandoned their holdings for the colony center.

label.en: Violence is a part of life.

descriptions.zh: 我以花庭之名，欢迎各位旅者。我是坦佩里翁国王，或者像我的族人所称呼的“金心者”，我并非以武力统治，而是通过先辈遗训和仪式来执掌权柄。我既是这个世界的守护者，也是我的人民——阿纳萨里——的引路人。听到你们自己的语言是否感到惊讶？不必害怕。自从你们决定将[Root.GetName]视为你们的家园以来，我们一直在研究你们。你们的人民一定非常强大，才能穿透我们的屏障。我们很荣幸能与你们相见。
descriptions.en: I welcome you, travelers, in the name of the Court of Blossoms. I am King Tamperion, or as my kinship calls me, the 'Goldenhearted', sovereign not by rule of force, but by legacy and ritual. I serve as custodian of the this world and shepherd of my people, the Anathari. Are you alarmed to hear your own language? Never fear. We have been studying you ever since you decided to call [Root.GetName] your home. You must be a powerful people indeed, if you have managed to penetrate our cloak. We are honored to meet you.

label.en: What is the Court of Blossoms?

label.zh: 我们来此地是为了建立殖民地。
label.en: We are here to establish a colony.

descriptions.zh: 谨代表鲜花之庭全员，衷心感谢您的合作。请放心，您先前派遣来的人员，我们将其视作贵客，使其宾至如归。绝不会让他们有任何需求上的短缺。
descriptions.en: On behalf of the entire Court of Blossoms, I extend our sincere gratitude for your cooperation. Rest assured, the one you send to us will be welcomed as one of our own, and there shall be nothing they want for.

descriptions.zh: 既如此，随你便吧。你已做了决定，我们亦然。我已尽了我的劝告之责，现在你必须承担你选择的后果。
descriptions.en: So be it. Your decision is made, and so is ours. I have offered my counsel, yet now you must bear the fruits of your choice.

label.zh: 我们必须为接下来任何可能发生的情况做好准备。
label.en: We will prepare ourselves for whatever follows.

descriptions.zh:
毫无预兆。坦佩里翁国王从花园的中心现身，身上披着由活体藤蔓和发光花朵编织而成的仪式盔甲。他沿着殖民地边缘，每一步都走得缓慢而庄重，整个世界也在苏醒。藤蔓从土壤中蜿蜒而出，花瓣如刀锋般绽放。空气中弥漫着金色的花粉，细微而闪耀。它渗透进通风口和肺部。几个小时之内，它夺走了许多人的生命，引发癫痫、疯狂，最终导致死亡。

最终，依靠殖民地的自动化防御系统的介入才将他击倒。坦佩里翁国王一言不发地倒下了；目击者说他最后的目光中没有仇恨，只有深深的、庄严的失望。

我们侦察兵发现，曾经的鲜花之庭所在之处，只剩下了森林。仿佛这个王国已经把自己折叠回了土壤之中，带走了它的秘密和它的悲伤。
descriptions.en:
There was no warning. King Tamperion emerged from the heart of the gardens, draped in ceremonial armor spun from living vines and bioluminescent blossoms. With each deliberate step along the colony's edge, the world itself awakened. Vines slithered from the soil, while petals unfurled like blades. The air grew thick with a golden pollen, fine and luminescent. It seeped into vents and lungs. Within hours, it had claimed the life of many, inducing seizures, madness, and finally, death.

Only the intervention of automated colony defenses eventually brought him down. King Tamperion fell without a word; witnesses say his final gaze held not hatred, but a deep and solemn disappointment.

Where the Court of Blossoms once was, our scouts found only forest. It is as though the kingdom had folded itself back into the soil, taking its secrets and its sorrow with it.

tooltips.zh: §R10%§!人口死亡。

descriptions.zh:
我们全身心投入了阿纳萨里的怀抱。我们参与他们的仪式并与他们独特的礼仪相协调，模式出现了，意义下也扎了根。

在以长寿周期和繁育为重点的夜间公众仪式中，阿纳萨里开始揭示被压抑的历史片段。他们谈到一种古老而持久的枯萎病，它不但曾经笼罩着这个星球，而且现在仍然威胁着阿纳萨里。
descriptions.en:
We immersed ourselves in the ways of the Anathari. As we participated in ceremonial rites and attuned with their peculiar rituals, patterns emerged while meaning took root.

During shared nocturnal ceremonies focused on longevity cycles and fertility, the Anathari began to reveal fragments of suppressed history. The folk spoke of an ancient and enduring blight that once blanketed the planet and still has control over the Anathari now.

descriptions.zh: 曾几何时，远在你们踏足这片土地之前，我们阿纳萨里曾经不过是卑微的管事。我们按照它的呼吸节奏塑造这颗星球，引导生态系统，平衡水流，像无限耐心的园丁照顾花园一般照料这颗有生命的星球。但这种平衡很快遭受到了挑战。
descriptions.en: There was a time, long before your kind set foot upon this soil, when we, the Anathari, served as noble stewards. We shaped this world in rhythm with its breath, guiding ecosystems, balancing currents, tending to the living world as one tends to a garden with infinite patience. Yet balance does not persist unchallenged for long.

label.zh: 我们必须阻止永朽之暗
label.en: We must stop this Dark Immortal.

label.zh: 我们可不能相信这个什么国王。
label.en: We can't trust this so-called king.

descriptions.zh:
起初的和平交流开始呈现出更令人不安的微妙一面。参加阿纳萨里仪式会导致报告延迟、记忆碎片化以及睡眠改变。坦佩里翁国王仍然彬彬有礼，但当被问及这些仪式的深层目的时，他却讳莫如深。他的解释固然富有诗意，却也闪烁其词。甚至他的那个“金心者”头衔，也没有出现在阿纳萨里教义的记录中。一些人现在认为，这些仪式不仅是文化纽带，也是心理校准的工具。

不管方式如何，结果都是明确的：我们正在与坦佩里翁和他的家族结盟。当他谈到永朽之暗的时候，感觉不像是外来的恳求，而更像是一种内在的神圣责任，帮助我们最亲爱的盟友，阿纳萨里。
descriptions.en:
What began as a peaceful exchange has taken on a subtler, more troubling dimensions. Participation in Anathari rites has resulted in delayed reports, fragmented memories, and altered sleep. King Tamperion remains courteous, but increasingly evasive when asked about the deeper purpose of these rites. His explanations, though poetic, often deflect direct inquiry. Even his title, 'Goldenhearted', appears in no recorded Anathari doctrine. Some now suggest the rituals serve not just as cultural bonding, but as tools of psychological calibration.

Whatever the method, the result is unmistakable: we are becoming aligned with Tamperion and his kin. When he speaks of the Dark Immortal, it feels less like foreign entreaty and more like a sacred duty to help our dearest allies, the Anathari.

label.zh: 当然，我们会帮助你们的。
label.en: Of course we are going to help you.

descriptions.zh:
我们迅速采取行动。一支民兵突击队渗透了鲜花之庭。我们袭击时，坦佩里翁国王在花园中冥想，但他也不是善茬。目击者的描述宛如一场植物的死亡之舞，藤蔓穿石而出，花茎在钢铁挠出道道抓痕。当国王终于被打倒时，整座花园已经被明亮的鲜血和灰烬浸透。

花园之下埋藏的东西让我们大吃一惊，这简直是一座生物宝库：古老的知识、植物工程和无数收获周期的遗传储备。这里的土壤比星球上其他地方都肥沃，如今也不再被古老的看护者所约束。我们可能正要进入一个物质丰富的黄金时代。
descriptions.en:
Our action was swift. A militia strike team infiltrated the Court of Blossoms. King Tamperion was meditating in the garden when we struck. But the king did not fall easily. Witnesses describe a terrifying display of botanical wrath, vines erupting from stone, floral constructs clawing through steel. By the time the king was brought down, the garden was soaked in luminous blood and ash.

What remained beneath the garden astonished us, as it was a vault of biological treasures: ancient knowledge, botanical engineering, and stores of genetic stock from countless harvest cycles. The soil, now unbound from its ancient caretakers, was more fertile than any yet found on the planet. We may be entering a golden age of abundance.
